text: Awsaf-e-Ilahi. Chunki duniya aur aakhirat ki sab ne'matein aur rahmatein Allah Ta'ala hi ki taraf se hain. Sari hukumaton ka haakim wahi ek hai. Is liye har qisam ki tareef-o-sana ka mustahiq bhi wahi hai. Wahi mabood hai jis ke siwa koi laiq-e-ibadat nahin. Isi ke liye duniya aur aakhirat ki hamd-o-sana sazawar hai. Isi ki hukumat hai aur isi ki taraf sab ke sab lautaye jate hain. Zameen-o-aasman mein jo kuch hai sab us ke mat-hat hai. Jitne bhi hain sab us ke ghulam hain. Us ke qabze mein hain, sab par tasarruf isi ka hai. Aakhirat mein isi ki tareefein hongi. Woh apne aqwal, af'aal, taqdeer, shariyat sab mein hukumat wala hai aur aisa khabardar hai jis par koi cheez makhfi nahin, jis se koi zarra posheeda nahin, jo apne ahkaam mein hakeem, jo apni makhlooq se bakhabar, jitne qatre barish ke zameen mein jate hain, jitne daane is mein boye jate hain, us ke ilm se bahar nahin. Jo zameen se nikalta hai, ugta hai, use bhi woh janta hai. Us ke muheet, wasee aur be-payan ilm se koi cheez door nahin. Har cheez ki ginti, kaifiyat aur sifat use maloom hai. Aasman se jo barish barasti hai, us ke qatron ki ginti bhi us ke ilm mein mehfooz hai, jo rizq wahan se utarta hai woh bhi us ke ilm mein hai, us ke ilm se nek a'maal waghera jo aasman par charhte hain woh bhi us ke ilm mein hain. Woh apne bandon par khud un se bhi zyada meharban hai. Isi wajah se un ke gunahon par ittila rakhte hue unhein jaldi se saza nahin deta balki mohlat deta hai ke woh tauba kar lein. Buraiyan chhor dein, Rabb ki taraf ruju karein. Phir Ghafoor hai. Idhar banda jhuka, roya, peeta, udhar us ne bakhash diya ya maaf farma diya, darguzar kar liya. Tauba karne wala dhutkara nahin jata, tawakkul karne wala nuqsan nahin uthata.

Qayamat aakar rahegi. Poore Quran mein teen aayatein hain jahan qayamat ke aane par qasam khakar bayan farmaya gaya hai. Ek toh Surah Yunus mein (وَيَسْتَنْۢبِـــُٔـوْنَكَ اَحَقٌّ ھُوَ ڼ قُلْ اِيْ وَرَبِّيْٓ اِنَّهٗ لَحَقٌّ ې وَمَآ اَنْتُمْ بِمُعْجِزِيْنَ 53؀) (Yunus: 53) log tujh se daryaft karte hain ke kya qayamat ka aana haq hi hai? Toh keh de ke haan haan mere Rab ki qasam woh yaqeenan haq hi hai aur tum Allah ko maghloob nahin kar sakte. Dusri aayat yehi. Teesri aayat Surah Taghabun mein (زَعَمَ الَّذِيْنَ كَفَرُوْٓا اَنْ لَّنْ يُّبْعَثُوْا ۭ قُلْ بَلٰى وَرَبِّيْ لَتُبْعَثُنَّ ثُمَّ لَتُـنَبَّؤُنَّ بِمَا عَمِلْتُمْ ۭ وَذٰلِكَ عَلَي اللّٰهِ يَسِيْرٌ) (At-Taghabun: 7) yani kuffar ka khayal hai ke woh qayamat ke din uthaye na jayenge. Toh keh de ke haan mere Rab ki qasam tum zaroor uthaye jaoge phir apne aamaal ki khabar diye jaoge aur yeh toh Allah par bilkul hi aasaan hai. Pas yahan bhi kafiron ke inkar-e-qayamat ka zikr karke apne Nabi (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ko un ke bare mein qasmiya bata kar phir us ki mazeed takeed karte hue farmata hai ke woh Allah jo Aalim-ul-Ghaib hai jis se koi zarra posheeda nahin. Sab us ke ilm mein hai. Go haddiyan sad gal jayen un ke reze mutafariq ho jayen lekin woh kahan hain? Kitne hain? Sab woh jaanta hai. Woh un sab ke jama karne par bhi qadir hai. Jaise ke pehle unhein paida kiya. Woh har cheez ka jaanne wala hai. Aur tamam cheezein us ke paas us ki Kitab mein bhi likhi hui hain, phir qayamat ke aane ki hikmat bayan farmayi ke imaan walon ko un ki nekiyon ka badla mile. Woh maghfirat aur rizq-e-kareem se nawaze jayen, aur jinhon ne Allah ki baaton se zid ki rasoolon ki na maani unhein badtareen aur sakht sazayein hon. Nek-kaar momin jaza aur bad-kaar kuffar saza payenge. Jaise farmaya jahannami aur jannati barabar nahin. Jannati kamyab aur maqsad-war hain. Aur aayat mein hai (اَمْ نَجْعَلُ الَّذِيْنَ اٰمَنُوْا وَعَمِلُوا الصّٰلِحٰتِ كَالْمُفْسِدِيْنَ فِي الْاَرْضِ ۡ اَمْ نَجْعَلُ الْمُتَّقِيْنَ كَالْفُجَّارِ 28؀) (Sad: 28), yani momin aur mufsid muttaqi aur fajir barabar nahin, phir qayamat ki ek aur hikmat bayan farmayi ke imandar bhi qayamat ke din jab nekon ko jaza aur badon ko saza hote hue dekhenge toh woh ilm-ul-yaqeen se ain-ul-yaqeen hasil kar lenge aur us waqt keh uthenge ke hamare Rab ke rasool hamare paas haq laye the. Aur us waqt kaha jayega ke yeh hai jis ka wada Rahman ne diya tha aur rasoolon ne sach sach keh diya tha. Allah ne toh likh diya tha ke tum qayamat tak rahoge toh ab qayamat ka din aa chuka. Woh Allah Aziz hai yani buland janab wala badi sarkar wala hai. Bahut izzat wala hai poore ghalbe wala hai. Na us par kisi ka bas na kisi ka zor. Har cheez us ke samne past aur aajiz. Woh qabil-e-tareef hai apne aqwal-o-afaal shar'a-o-fel mein. In tamam mein us ki sari makhlooq us ki sana-khwan hai. Jalla wa Aala.

Kafiron ki jahalat. Kafir aur mulhid jo Qayamat ke aane ko muhal jaante thay aur is par Allah ke Nabi (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ka mazaq udate thay un ke kufriya kalmaat ka zikr ho raha hai ke woh aapas mein kehte thay "Lo aur suno hum mein ek sahib hain jo farmate hain ke jab mar kar mitti mein mil jayenge aur chura chura aur reza reza ho jayenge us ke baad bhi hum zinda kiye jayenge, is shakhs ki nisbat do hi khayal ho sakte hain ya toh yeh ke hosh-o-hawas ki durusti mein woh amdan Allah ke zimme ek jhoot bol raha hai aur jo us ne nahin farmaya woh us ki taraf nisbat karke yeh keh raha hai aur agar yeh nahin toh is ka dimagh kharab hai, majnoon hai, be-soche samjhe jo jee mein aaye keh deta hai." Allah Ta'ala unhein jawab deta hai ke yeh dono baatein nahin. An-Hazrat (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) sachay hain, nek hain, rah-yafta hain, dana hain, batini aur zahiri baseerat wale hain. Lekin isay kya kaha jaye ke munkir log jahalat aur nadani se kaam le rahe hain aur gaur-o-fikr se baat ki teh tak pahunchne ki koshish hi nahin karte. Jis ki wajah se haq baat aur seedhi rah un se chhoot jati hai aur woh bahut door nikal jate hain, kya is ki qudrat mein tum koi kami dekh rahe ho. Jis ne muheet aasman aur baseet zameen paida kar di. Jahan jao na aasman ka saya khatam ho na zameen ka farsh. Jaise farman hai (Wa-sama'a banaynaha bi-aydin wa-inna lamusi'un) (Surah (Az-Zariyat: 47). Hum ne aasman ko apne hathon banaya aur hum kushadgi wale hain. Zameen ko hum ne hi bichaya aur hum bahut achay bichane wale hain. Yahan bhi farmaya ke aagay dekho peechay dekho, isi tarah dayen nazar dalo, bayen taraf iltifat karo toh wasee aasman aur baseet zameen hi nazar aayegi. Itni badi makhlooq ka khaliq, itni zabardast qudraton par qadir kya tum jaisi chhoti si makhlooq ko fana karke phir paida karne par qudrat kho baitha? Woh toh qadir hai ke agar chahe tumhein zameen mein dhansa de. Ya aasman tum par tod de yaqeenan tumhare zulm aur gunah isi qabil hain lekin Allah ka hukm aur afw hai ke woh tumhein mohlat diye hue hai. Jis mein aql ho jis mein door-beeni ka madda ho jis mein gaur-o-fikr ki aadat ho, jis ki Allah ki taraf jhukne wali tabiyat ho, jis ke seene mein dil, dil mein hikmat aur hikmat mein noor ho woh toh in zabardast nishanat ko dekhne ke baad is Qadir-o-Khaliq Allah ki is qudrat mein shak kar hi nahin sakta ke marne ke baad phir jeena hai. Aasmanon jaise shamiyane aur zameenon jaise farsh jis ne paida kar diye us par insaan ki paidaish kya mushkil hai? Jis ne haddiyon, gosht, khaal ko ibtidaan paida kiya. Usay un ke sad gal jaane aur reza reza ho kar jhad jaane ke baad ikattha karke utha bithana kya bhari hai? Hazrat Dawood A.S par in'amat-e-Ilahi. Allah Ta'ala bayan farmata hai ke usne apne bande aur Rasool Hazrat Dawood A.S par dunyawi aur ukhrawi rahmat nazil farmayi. Nabuwwat bhi di, badshahat bhi di, lao lashkar bhi diye, taqat-o-quwwat bhi di. Phir ek pakeeza mojiza yeh ata farmaya ke udhar naghma-e-Dawoodi hawa mein goonja, udhar paharon aur parindon ko bhi wajd aa gaya. Paharon ne awaz mein awaz mila kar Allah ki hamd-o-sana shuru ki, parindon ne par hilane chhor diye aur apni qisam qisam ki pyari pyari boliyon mein Rabb ki wahdaniyat ke geet gane lage. Sahih hadith mein hai ke raat ko Hazrat Abu Musa Ash'ari R.A Quran-e-Pak ki tilawat kar rahe the jise sun kar Allah ke Rasool ﷺ thahar gaye, der tak sunte rahe, phir farmane lage inhe naghma-e-Dawoodi ka kuch hissa mil gaya hai. Abu Usman Nahdi ka bayan hai ke wallah hum ne Hazrat Abu Musa se zyada pyari awaz kisi baje ki bhi nahin suni. Awwibi ke ma'ani Habshi zaban mein yeh hain ke tasbeeh bayan karo. Lekin hamare nazdeek is mein mazeed gaur ki zaroorat hai, lughat-e-Arab mein yeh lafz tarjee' ke ma'ani mein majood hai. Pas paharon ko aur parindon ko hukm ho raha hai ke woh Hazrat Dawood A.S ki awaz ke sath apni awaz bhi mila liya karein. Ta'weeb ke ek ma'ani din ko chalne ke bhi aate hain. Jaise sari ke ma'ani raat ko chalne ke hain lekin yeh ma'ani bhi yahan kuch zyada munasibat nahin rakhta, yahan to yahi matlab hai ke Dawood A.S ki tasbeeh ki awaz mein tum bhi awaz mila kar khush-awazi se Rabb ki hamd bayan karo. Aur fazl un par yeh hua ke un ke liye loha narm kar diya gaya, na unhe lohe ki bhatti mein dalne ki zaroorat, na hathore marne ki haajat, hath mein aate hi aisa ho jata tha jaise dhage, ab is lohe se ba-farman-e-Allah aap zarhein banate the. Balkeh yeh bhi kaha gaya hai ke duniya mein sab se pehle zarah aap hi ne ijad ki hai. Har roz sirf ek zarah banate, us ki qeemat chhe hazar logon ke khilane pilane mein sarf kar dete. Zarah banane ki tarkeeb khud Allah ki sikhayi hui thi ke kariyaan theek theek rakhein, halqe chhote na hon ke theek na baithein, bahut bade na hon ke dheela pan rah jaye, balkeh naap tol aur sahih andaz se halqe aur kariyaan hon. Ibn-e-Asakir mein hai Hazrat Dawood A.S bhes badal kar nikla karte aur ri'aya ke logon se mil kar un se aur bahar ke aane jane walon se daryaft farmate ke Dawood kaisa aadmi hai? Lekin har shakhs ko tareefein karta hua hi paate. Kisi se koi baat apni nisbat qabil-e-islah na sunte. Ek martaba Allah Ta'ala ne ek farishte ko insani surat mein nazil farmaya. Hazrat Dawood A.S ki un se bhi mulaqat hui to jaise auron se poochte the un se bhi sawal kiya, unhon ne kaha ke Dawood hai to achha aadmi agar ek kami is mein na hoti to kamil ban jata. Aap ne badi raghbat se poocha ke woh kya? Farmaya woh apna bojh musalmanon ke Bait-ul-Maal par dale hue hain, khud bhi isi mein se leta hai aur apne ahl-o-ayal ko bhi isi mein se khilata hai.

Hazrat Dawood A.S ke dil mein yeh baat baith gayi ke yeh shakhs theek kehta hai. Usi waqt Janab-e-Bari ki taraf jhuk pade aur girya-o-zari ke sath duayein karne lage ke Allah mujhe koi kaam-kaaj aisa sikha de jis se mera pet bhar jaya kare. Koi sanat aur karigari mujhe bata de jis se main itna hasil kar liya karoon ke woh mujhe aur mere baal-bachon ko kafi ho jaye. Allah Ta'ala ne unhein zirein banana sikhayin aur phir apni rahmat se lohay ko un ke liye bilkul narm kar diya. Sab se pehle zirein aap ne hi banayi hain. Ek zirah banakar farokht farmate aur us ki qeemat ke teen hissay kar lete; ek apne khane peene waghera ke liye, ek sadqay ke liye, ek rakh chhorne ke liye taake dusri zirah banane tak Allah ke bandon ko dete rahein. Hazrat Dawood A.S ko jo naghma diya gaya tha woh to mahaz be-nazeer tha. Allah ki kitab Zaboor parhne ko baithte. Awaaz nikalte hi charand parand sabr-o-sukoon ke sath mahwiyat ke aalam mein aap ki awaaz se mutasir ho kar Kitabullah ki tilawat mein mashghool ho jate. Saare bajay shayateen ne naghma-e-Dawoodi se nikale hain. Aap ki be-misl khush-awazi ki yeh chirawni jaisi naqlein hain. Apni ne'amaton ko bayan farma kar hukum deta hai ke ab tumhein bhi chahiye ke nek aamaal karte raho. Mere farman ke khilaf na karo. Yeh bahut buri baat hai ke jis ke itne bare aur be-payan ehsaan hon, us ki farmanbardari tark kar di jaye. Main tumhare aamaal ka nigran hoon. Tumhara koi amal chhota bara, nek bad mujh se posheeda nahin.

Allah ki ne'matein aur Sulaiman Alaihis Salam. Hazrat Dawood A.S par jo ne'matein nazil farmayi thin un ko bayan karke phir aap ke farzand Hazrat Sulaiman A.S par jo ne'matein nazil farmayi thin un ka bayan ho raha hai ke un ke liye hawa ko tabe'-e-farman bana diya. Mahine bhar ki rah subh hi subh ho jati aur utni hi musafat ka safar sham ko ho jata. Maslan, Damishq se takht ma' fauj-o-asbab ke udaya aur thodi der mein Istakhar pahuncha diya jo tez sawar ke liye bhi mahine bhar ka safar tha. Isi tarah sham ko wahan se takht uda aur sham hi ko Kabul pahunch gaya. Tanbe ko bator-e-pani karke Allah Ta'ala ne us ke chashme baha diye the ke jis kaam mein jis tarah jis waqt lana chahein to bila-waqt le liya karein. Yeh tanba unhi ke waqt se kaam mein aa raha hai. Suddi ka qaul hai ke teen din tak yeh behta raha. Jinnat ko un ki matahti mein kar diya jo woh chahte apne samne un se kaam lete. Un mein se jo jinn ahkam-e-Sulaiman ki ta'meel se ji churata foran aag se jala diya jata. Ibn-e-Abi Hatim mein hai Rasool Allah ﷺ farmate hain jinnat ki teen qismein hain, ek to par-dar hai. Dusri qism saanp aur kutte hain, teesri qism woh hai jo sawariyon par sawar hote hain utarte hain waghera. Yeh hadith bahut ghareeb hai. Ibn-e-Na'am se riwayat hai ke jinnat ki teen qismein hain, ek ke liye to azab-o-sawab hai, ek aasman-o-zameen mein udte rehte hain, ek saanp kutte hain. Insanon ki bhi teen qismein hain. Ek woh jinhein Allah Ta'ala apne arsh tale saya de ga jis din us ke saye ke siwaye aur koi saya na hoga. Aur ek qism misl-e-chopayon ke hai balkeh un se bhi badtar. Aur teesri qism insani surat mein shaitani dil rakhne wale. Hazrat Hasan farmate hain jinn Iblees ki aulad mein se hain aur insan Hazrat Adam A.S ki aulad mein se hain, dono mein momin bhi hain aur kafir bhi. Azab-o-sawab mein dono shareek hain, dono ke imandar wali-e-Allah hain aur dono ke be-iman shaitan hain. Mahareeb kehte hain behtareen imaraton ko, ghar ke behtareen hisse ko, majlis ki sadarat ki jagah ko. Ba-qaul-e-Mujahid un imaraton ko jo mehalat se kam darje ki hon. Zahhak farmate hain masjidon ko. Qatada kehte hain bade bade mehal aur masjidon ko. Ibn-e-Zaid kehte hain gharon ko. Tamaseel tasweeron ko kehte hain, yeh tanbe ki thin. Ba-qaul-e-Qatada woh mitti aur sheeshe ki thin. Jawab jama hai Jabiya ki. Jabiya us hauz ko kehte hain jis mein pani aata rehta ho. Yeh misl-e-talab ke thin, bahut bade bade lagan the taake Hazrat Sulaiman A.S ki bahut badi fauj ke liye bahut sa khana ba-waqt taiyar ho sake aur un ke samne laya ja sake. Aur jami hui deigein jo ba-wajah apni badai ke aur bhari pan ke idhar se udhar nahin ki ja sakti thin. Un se Allah ne farma diya tha ke deen-o-duniya ki jo ne'matein main ne tumhein de rakhi hain un par mera shukr karo.

Shukr masdar hai baghair fe'l ke ya maf'ool-e-lah hai aur dono taqdeeron par is mein dalalat hai ke shukr jis tarah qaul aur irada se hota hai fe'l se bhi hota hai, jaise shair ka qaul hai: "Afadtukumun-na'ma'u minni salasa, yadi wa lisani waz-zameerul-muhajja". Is mein bhi shair ne'maton ka shukr teenon tarah maanta hai; fe'l se, zaban se aur dil se. Hazrat Abdur-Rahman Sulmi R.H se marwi hai ke namaz bhi shukr hai aur roza bhi shukr hai aur har bhala amal jise tu Allah ke liye kare, shukr hai aur sab se afzal shukr hamd hai. Muhammad bin Ka'ab Qurzi farmate hain shukr Allah Ta'ala ka taqwa aur nek amal hai. Aal-e-Dawood dono tarah ka shukr ada karte thay, qaulan bhi aur fe'lan bhi. Sabit Bunani R.H farmate hain: "Hazrat Dawood A.S ne apne ahl-o-ayal, aulad aur aurton par is tarah auqat ki pabandi ke sath nafl namaz taqseem ki thi ke har waqt koi na koi namaz mein mashghool nazar aata." Bukhari-o-Muslim mein hai Rasool Allah ﷺ farmate hain Allah ko sab se zyada pasand Hazrat Dawood A.S ki namaz thi. Aap aadhi raat sote, tihai raat qayam karte aur chatha hissa so rehte. Isi tarah sab rozon se zyada mehboob rozay bhi Allah Ta'ala ko aap hi ke thay, aap ek din rozay se rehte aur ek din be-roza. Ek khoobi aap mein yeh thi ke dushman se jihad ke waqt munh na pherte. Ibn-e-Majah mein hai ke Hazrat Sulaiman A.S ki walida-e-majida ne aap se farmaya ke pyare bache raat ko bahut na soya karo. Raat ki zyada neend insaan ko Qayamat ke din faqeer bana deti hai. Ibn-e-Abi Hatim R.H mein is mauqa par Hazrat Dawood A.S ki ek mutawwal hadith marwi hai. Isi kitab mein yeh bhi marwi hai ke Hazrat Dawood A.S ne janab-e-bari mein arz kiya ke Ilah-ul-Alameen tera shukr kaise ada hoga? Shukr-guzari khud teri ek ne'mat hai. Jawab mila: "Dawood! ab tu ne meri shukr-guzari ada kar li jabke tu ne ise jaan liya ke kul ne'maten meri hi taraf se hain." Phir ek waqiye ki khabar di jaati hai ke bandon mein se shukr-guzar banday bahut hi kam hain.

Allah ki ne'matein aur Sulaiman Alaihis Salam. Hazrat Dawood A.S par jo ne'matein nazil farmayi thin un ko bayan karke phir aap ke farzand Hazrat Sulaiman A.S par jo ne'matein nazil farmayi thin un ka bayan ho raha hai ke un ke liye hawa ko tabe'-e-farman bana diya. Mahine bhar ki rah subh hi subh ho jati aur utni hi musafat ka safar sham ko ho jata. Maslan, Damishq se takht ma' fauj-o-asbab ke udaya aur thodi der mein Istakhar pahuncha diya jo tez sawar ke liye bhi mahine bhar ka safar tha. Isi tarah sham ko wahan se takht uda aur sham hi ko Kabul pahunch gaya. Tanbe ko bator-e-pani karke Allah Ta'ala ne us ke chashme baha diye the ke jis kaam mein jis tarah jis waqt lana chahein to bila-waqt le liya karein. Yeh tanba unhi ke waqt se kaam mein aa raha hai. Suddi ka qaul hai ke teen din tak yeh behta raha. Jinnat ko un ki matahti mein kar diya jo woh chahte apne samne un se kaam lete. Un mein se jo jinn ahkam-e-Sulaiman ki ta'meel se ji churata foran aag se jala diya jata. Ibn-e-Abi Hatim mein hai Rasool Allah ﷺ farmate hain jinnat ki teen qismein hain, ek to par-dar hai. Dusri qism saanp aur kutte hain, teesri qism woh hai jo sawariyon par sawar hote hain utarte hain waghera. Yeh hadith bahut ghareeb hai. Ibn-e-Na'am se riwayat hai ke jinnat ki teen qismein hain, ek ke liye to azab-o-sawab hai, ek aasman-o-zameen mein udte rehte hain, ek saanp kutte hain. Insanon ki bhi teen qismein hain. Ek woh jinhein Allah Ta'ala apne arsh tale saya de ga jis din us ke saye ke siwaye aur koi saya na hoga. Aur ek qism misl-e-chopayon ke hai balkeh un se bhi badtar. Aur teesri qism insani surat mein shaitani dil rakhne wale. Hazrat Hasan farmate hain jinn Iblees ki aulad mein se hain aur insan Hazrat Adam A.S ki aulad mein se hain, dono mein momin bhi hain aur kafir bhi. Azab-o-sawab mein dono shareek hain, dono ke imandar wali-e-Allah hain aur dono ke be-iman shaitan hain. Mahareeb kehte hain behtareen imaraton ko, ghar ke behtareen hisse ko, majlis ki sadarat ki jagah ko. Ba-qaul-e-Mujahid un imaraton ko jo mehalat se kam darje ki hon. Zahhak farmate hain masjidon ko. Qatada kehte hain bade bade mehal aur masjidon ko. Ibn-e-Zaid kehte hain gharon ko. Tamaseel tasweeron ko kehte hain, yeh tanbe ki thin. Ba-qaul-e-Qatada woh mitti aur sheeshe ki thin. Jawab jama hai Jabiya ki. Jabiya us hauz ko kehte hain jis mein pani aata rehta ho. Yeh misl-e-talab ke thin, bahut bade bade lagan the taake Hazrat Sulaiman A.S ki bahut badi fauj ke liye bahut sa khana ba-waqt taiyar ho sake aur un ke samne laya ja sake. Un se Allah ne farma diya tha ke deen-o-duniya ki jo ne'matein main ne tumhein de rakhi hain un par mera shukr karo.

Jawab mila: "Dawood! ab tu ne meri shukr-guzari ada kar li jabke tu ne ise jaan liya ke kul ne'maten meri hi taraf se hain." Phir ek waqiye ki khabar di jaati hai ke bandon mein se shukr-guzar banday bahut hi kam hain.

Hazrat Sulaiman A.S ki wafat. Hazrat Sulaiman A.S ki maut ki kaifiyat bayan ho rahi hai aur yeh bhi ke jo jinnaat unke farman ke tehat kaam-kaaj mein masroof thay un par unki maut kaise namaloom rahi, woh inteqal ke baad bhi lakdi ke teke par khade hi rahe aur yeh unhein zinda samajhte hue sar jhukaye apne sakht sakht kaamon mein mashghool rahe. Mujahid wagaira farmate hain taqreeban saal bhar isi tarah guzar gaya. Jis lakdi ke sahare aap khade thay jab use deemak chaat gayi aur woh khokhli ho gayi toh aap gir pade. Ab jinnaat aur insaanon ko aapki maut ka pata chala. Tab toh na sirf insaanon balkay khud jinnaat ko bhi yaqeen ho gaya ke un mein se koi bhi ghaib daan nahin. Ek marfoo munkar aur ghareeb hadith mein hai ke lekin tehqeeqi baat yeh hai ke iska marfoo hona theek nahin, farmate hain ke Hazrat Sulaiman A.S jab namaz padhte toh ek darakht apne samne dekhte, us se poochte ke tu kaisa darakht hai, tera naam kya hai. Woh bata deta, aap use usi istemaal mein late. Ek martaba jab namaz ko khade hue aur isi tarah ek darakht dekha toh poocha tera naam kya hai? Usne kaha Zaroub. Poocha tu kis liye hai? Kaha is ghar ko ujadne ke liye. Tab aapne dua mangi ke Allah meri maut ki khabar jinnaat par zahir na hone de taake insaan ko yaqeen ho jaye ke jinn ghaib nahin jante. Ab aap ek lakdi par tek laga kar khade hue aur jinnaat ko mushkil mushkil kaam sonp diye, aapka inteqal ho gaya lekin lakdi ke sahare aap waise hi khade rahe, jinnaat dekhte rahe aur samajhte rahe ke aap zinda hain, apne apne kaam mein mashghool rahe, ek saal kaamil ho gaya. Chunke deemak aapki lakdi ko chaat rahi thi, saal bhar guzarne par woh use kha gayi aur ab Hazrat Sulaiman gir pade aur insaanon ne jaan liya ke jinnaat ghaib nahin jante warna saal bhar tak is museebat mein na rehte. Lekin iske ek rawi Atta bin Muslim Khurasani ki baaz ahadees mein nakarat hoti hai. Baaz sahaba se marwi hai ke Hazrat Sulaiman A.S ki aadat thi, aap saal saal, do do saal ya kam-o-besh muddat ke liye Masjid-e-Quds mein aitikaf mein baith jate. Aakhri martaba inteqal ke waqt bhi aap Masjid-e-Bait-ul-Muqaddas mein thay, har subh ek darakht aapke samne namoodar hota. Aap us se naam poochte, faida poochte, woh batata, aap usi kaam mein use late. Bil-aakhir ek darakht zahir hua jisne apna naam Zarouba bataya, kaha tu kis matlab ka hai? Kaha is masjid ke ujadne ke liye. Hazrat Sulaiman A.S samajh gaye, farmane lage meri zindagi mein toh yeh masjid veeran hogi nahin, albata tu meri maut aur is shehar ki veerani ke liye hai. Chunancha aapne use apne bagh mein laga diya, masjid ki beech ki jagah mein khade ho kar ek lakdi ke sahare namaz shuru kar di. Wahin inteqal ho gaya lekin kisi ko iska ilm na hua. Shayateen sab ke sab apni naukri baja late rahe ke aisa na ho hum dheel karein aur Allah ke Rasool aa jayein toh hamein saza dein.

Yeh mihrab ke aage peeche aaye, in mein jo ek bahut bada paaji shaitan tha usne kaha dekho ji is mein aage aur peeche surakh hain agar main yahan se jakar wahan se nikal aaun to meri taqat ko manoge ya nahin? Chunancha woh gaya aur nikal aaya lekin use Hazrat Sulaiman (A.S) ki aawaz na aayi. Dekh to sakte na the kyunke Hazrat Sulaiman (A.S) ki taraf nigah bhar kar dekhte hi woh mar jate the lekin uske dil mein kuch khayal sa guzra usne phir aur jurrat ki aur masjid mein chala gaya dekhta ki wahan jane ke baad woh na jala to uski himmat aur badh gayi aur usne nigah bhar kar aap ko dekha to dekha ki woh gire pade hain aur inteqal farma chuke hain. Ab aakar sab ko khabar ki, log aaye, mihrab ko khola to waqai Allah ke Rasool ko zinda na paya. Aap ko masjid se nikal laye. Muddat-e-inteqal ka ilm hasil karne ke liye unhon ne lakdi ko deemak ke samne daal diya, ek din raat tak jis qadar deemak ne use khaya use dekh kar andaza kiya to maloom hua ki aap ke inteqal ko poora saal guzar chuka. Tamam logon ko us waqt kamil yaqeen ho gaya ki jinnat jo bante the ki hum ghaib ki khabrein jante hain yeh mehez unki dhons thi warna saal bhar tak kyun museebat jhelte rehte. Us waqt se jinnat ghan ke keede ko mitti aur pani la diya karte hain goya uska shukriya ada karte hain. Kaha yeh bhi tha ki agar tu kuch khata peeta hota to behtar se behtar ghiza hum tujhe pahunchate lekin yeh sab Bani Israel ke ulama ki riwayatein hain, in mein jo mutabiq-e-haq hon qabool, khilaf-e-haq hon mardood, donon se alag hon woh na tasdeeq ke qabil na takzeeb ke, wallahu a'lam-ul-ghaib. Hazrat Zaid bin Aslam (R.H) se marwi hai ki Hazrat Sulaiman (A.S) ne Malak-ul-Maut se keh rakha tha ki meri maut ka waqt mujhe kuch pehle bata dena. Hazrat Malak-ul-Maut ne yahi kiya to aap ne jinnat ko baghair darwaze ke ek sheeshe ka makan banane ka hukum diya aur us mein ek lakdi par tek lagakar namaz shuru ki, yeh maut ke darr ki wajah se na tha. Hazrat Malak-ul-Maut apne waqt par aaye aur rooh qabz karke gaye. Phir lakdi ke sahare aap saal bhar tak isi tarah khade rahe, jinnat idhar udhar se dekh kar aap ko zinda samajh kar apne kamon mein aap ki haibat ki wajah se mashghool rahe lekin jo keeda aap ki lakdi ko kha raha tha jab woh aadhi khachuka to ab lakdi bojh na utha saki aur aap gir pade, jinnat ko aap ki maut ka yaqeen ho gaya aur woh bhag khade hue. Aur bhi bahut se aqwal salaf se yeh marwi hain.

Qaum-e-Saba ka tafseeli tazkirah. Qaum-e-Saba Yaman mein rehti thi. Tubba bhi in mein se hi thay. Balqees bhi inhi mein se thin. Yeh bari nematon aur rahaton mein thay. Chain-o-aaram se zindagi guzar rahe thay. Allah ke Rasool in ke paas aaye, unhein shukr karne ki talqeen ki. Rabb ki wahdaniyat ki taraf bulaya, us ki ibadat ka tareeqa samjhaya. Kuch zamane tak woh yunhi rahe lekin phir jabke unhon ne sartabi aur rogardani ki, ahkam-e-Ilahi be-parwahi se taal diye to un par zor ka sailab aaya aur tamam mulk, baghat aur khetiyan waghera takht-o-taraj ho gayin. Jis ki tafseel yeh hai. Rasool Allah (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) se sawal hua ke Saba kisi aurat ka naam hai ya mard ka ya jagah ka? To aap (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne farmaya yeh ek mard tha jis ke das larkay thay jin mein se chhay to Yaman mein ja basay thay aur char Sham mein. Madhhaj, Kinda, Azd, Ash'ari, Aghar, Hamyariya yeh chhay qabeelay Yaman mein. Lakhm, Judham, Amila aur Ghassan yeh char qabeelay Sham mein. (Musnad-e-Ahmad). Farwa bin Musaik farmate hain main ne Rasool Allah (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) se poocha ke main apni qaum mein se manne walon aur aagay barhne walon ko le kar na manne aur peeche hatne walon se laron? Aap (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne farmaya haan. Jab main jaane laga to aap (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne mujhe bula kar farmaya dekho pehle unhein Islam ki dawat dena, na manen tab jihad ki tayari karna. Main ne kaha Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) yeh Saba kis ka naam hai? To aap (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ka jawab taqreeban wahi hai jo oopar mazkoor hua. Is mein yeh bhi hai ke qabeela Anmar mein se Bajila aur Khath'am bhi hain. Ek aur mutawwal riwayat mein is aayat ke shaan-e-nuzool ke mutaliq is ke sath yeh bhi hai ke Hazrat Farwa (R.A) ne Aan-Hazrat (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) se kaha tha ke Ya Rasool Allah (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) jahiliyat ke zamane mein qaum-e-Saba ki izzat thi, mujhe ab un ke irtidad ka khauf hai. Agar aap ijazat dein to main un se jihad karoon. Aap (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne farmaya un ke bare mein mujhe koi hukm nahin diya gaya. Pas yeh aayat utri. Lekin is mein gharabat hai, is se to yeh paya jata hai ke yeh aayat Madani hai, halankeh soorat Makkiya hai. Muhammad bin Ishaq Saba ka nasab-nama is tarah bayan karte hain: Abd-e-Shams bin Yashjub bin Ya'rub bin Qahtan. Isay Saba is liye kehte hain ke us ne sab se pehle Arab mein dushman ko qaid karne ka riwaj dala. Is wajah se isay Ra'ish bhi kehte hain. Maal ko Reesh aur Riyash bhi Arabi mein kehte hain. Yeh bhi mazkoor hai ke is badshah ne Aan-Hazrat (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ke tashreef lane se pehle hi aap (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ki pesh-goi ki thi ke mulk ka malik hamare baad ek Nabi hoga jo Haram ki izzat kare ga. Is ke baad us ke khalifa honge, jin ke samne duniya ke badshah sar-nigoon ho jayenge, phir hum mein bhi badshahat aayegi aur Banu Qahtan ke ek Nabi bhi honge. Us Nabi ka naam Ahmad hoga (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam). Kash ke main bhi un ki nabuwat ke zamane ko pa leta to har tarah ki khidmat ko ghaneemat samajhta. Logo jab bhi Allah ke woh Rasool (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) zahir hon to tum par farz hai ke un ka sath do aur un ke madadgar ban jao aur jo bhi aap (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) se mile us par meri janib se farz hai ke woh aap (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ki khidmat mein mera salam pahuncha de.

(Aqeel Hamdani) Qahtan ke bare mein teen qaul hain. Ek yeh ke woh Aram bin Sam bin Nooh ki nasl mein se hai. Dusra yeh ke woh Aabir yani Hazrat Hood (A.S) ki nasl mein se hai. Teesra yeh ke Hazrat Ismail bin Ibrahim (Alaihima-us-Salam) ki nasl se hai. Is sab ko tafseel ke sath Hafiz Abdul Barr (R.H) ne apni kitab Al-Anbah mein zikr kiya hai. Baaz riwayaton mein jo aaya hai ke Saba Arab mein se thay, is ka matlab yeh hai ke un logon mein se jin ki nasl se Arab huay. Un ka nasl-e-Ibrahimi mein se hona mashhoor nahin. Wallahu A'lam. Sahih Bukhari mein hai ke qabeela Aslam jab teeron se nishana bazi kar rahe thay aur Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) un ke paas niklay to Aap (ﷺ) ne farmaya: "Aye aulad-e-Ismail! Teer-andazi kiye jao, tumhare walid bhi pooray teer-andaz thay." Is se to maloom hota hai ke Saba ka silsila-e-nasab Khalil-ur-Rahman (A.S) tak pahunchta hai. Aslam Ansar ka ek qabeela tha aur Ansar saray ke saray Ghassan mein se hain aur yeh sab Yamani thay, Saba ki aulad hain. Yeh log Madine mein us waqt aaye jab sailab se un ka watan tabah ho gaya. Ek jamaat yahin aa kar basi thi, dusri Sham chali gayi. Inhein Ghassani is liye kehte hain ke is naam ki pani wali ek jagah par yeh thehray thay. Yeh bhi kaha gaya hai ke yeh Mishaal ke qareeb hai. Hazrat Hassan bin Thabit (R.A) ke sher se yeh bhi sabit hota hai ke ek pani wali jagah ya us kuanay ka naam Ghassan tha. Yeh jo Huzoor (ﷺ) ne farmaya ke us ki das auladein thin, is se murad sulbi auladein nahin kyunke baaz baaz do do teen teen naslon baad ke bhi hain, jaise ke kutub-e-ansab mein majood hai. Jo Sham aur Yaman mein ja kar abad huay, yeh bhi sailab ke aanay ke baad ka zikr hai. Baaz wahin rahay, baaz idhar udhar chalay gaye. Deewar ka qissa yeh hai ke un ke dono janib pahar thay, jahan se nehrein aur chashmay beh beh kar un ke shehron mein aatay thay, isi tarah naalay aur darya bhi idhar udhar se aatay thay. Un ke qadeemi badshahon mein se kisi ne un dono paharon ke darmiyan ek mazboot pushta banwa diya tha, jis deewar ki wajah se pani idhar udhar ho gaya tha aur ba-surat-e-darya jaari raha karta tha, jis ke dono janib baghaat aur khetiyan laga di thin. Pani ki kasrat aur zameen ki umdagi ki wajah se yeh khitta bahut hi zarkhez aur hara bhara raha karta tha. Yahan tak ke Hazrat Qatada (R.A) ka bayan hai ke koi aurat apne sar par jhulli rakh kar chalti thi, kuch door jaanay tak phalon se woh jhulli bilkul bhar jati thi. Darakhton se phal khud-ba-khud jo jhartay thay woh is qadar kasrat se hotay thay ke hath se tornay ki haajat nahin parti thi. Yeh deewar Ma'rib mein thi, Sana'a se teen marahil par thi aur Sadd-e-Ma'rib ke naam se mashhoor thi. Aab-o-hawa ki umdagi, sehat, mizaj aur aitidal Inayat-e-Ilahiya se is tarah tha ke un ke han makkhi, machhar aur zehreeley janwar bhi nahin hotay thay. Yeh is liye tha ke woh log Allah ki tauheed ko maanein aur dil-o-jaan se us ki khuloos ke sath ibadat karein.

Yeh thi woh nishani-e-qudrat jis ka zikr is aayat mein hai ke dono paharon ke darmiyan aabad basti aur basti ke dono taraf hare bhare phal-dar baghaat aur sarsabz khetiyan aur un se Janab-e-Bari ne farma diya tha ke apne Rab ki di hui roziyan khao piyo aur us ke shukr mein lage raho, lekin unhon ne Allah ki tauheed ko aur us ki nematon ke shukr ko bhula diya aur suraj ki parastish karne lage. Jaise ke hudhud ne Hazrat Sulaiman (A.S) ko khabar di thi ke (وَجِئْتُكَ مِنْ سَبَاٍۢ بِنَبَاٍ يَّقِيْنٍ 22) (Surah (An-Naml: 22), yani main tumhare paas Saba ki ek pukhta khabar laya hoon. Ek aurat un ki badshahat kar rahi hai jis ke paas tamam cheezein majood hain, azeem-ush-shan takht-e-saltanat par woh mutamakkin hai. Rani aur riyaya sab suraj parast hain. Shaitan ne un ko gumrah kar rakha hai, be-rah ho rahe hain. Marwi hai ke barah ya terah paighambar un ke paas aaye thay. Bil-aakhir shamat-e-aamaal rang layi, jo deewar unhon ne bana rakhi thi woh choohon ne andar se khokhli kar di aur barish ke zamane mein woh toot gayi, pani ki rail-pel ho gayi. Un daryaoon ke, chashmon ke, barish ke nalon ke, sab pani aa gaye, un ki bastiyan, un ke mehalat, un ke baghaat aur un ki khetiyan sab tabah-o-barbad ho gayin. Haath malte reh gaye, koi tadbeer kargar na hui. Phir toh woh tabahi aayi ke us zameen par koi phal-dar darakht jamta hi na tha. Peelu, jhao, kikar, babool aur aise hi be-mewa bad-maza be-kar darakht ugate thay. Haan albatta kuch beriyon ke darakht ug aaye thay jo nisbatan aur darakhton se kar-aamad thay, lekin woh bhi bahut zyada khar-dar aur bahut kam phal-dar thay. Yeh tha un ke kufr-o-shirk ki sarkashi aur takabbur ka badla ke nematein kho baithe aur zakhmon mein mubtala ho gaye. Kafiron ko yahi aur is jaisi hi sakht sazayein di jati hain. Hazrat Abu Khaira farmate hain gunahon ka badla yahi hota hai ke ibadaton mein susti aa jaye, rozgar mein tangi waqay ho, lazzaton mein sakhti aa jaye, yani jahan kisi rahat ka munh dekha foran koi zahmat aa padi aur maza mitti ho gaya.)

Qaum-e-Saba ka tafseeli tazkirah. Qaum-e-Saba Yaman mein rehti thi. Tubba bhi in mein se hi thay. Balqees bhi inhi mein se thin. Yeh bari nematon aur rahaton mein thay. Chain-o-aaram se zindagi guzar rahe thay. Allah ke Rasool in ke paas aaye, unhein shukr karne ki talqeen ki. Rabb ki wahdaniyat ki taraf bulaya, us ki ibadat ka tareeqa samjhaya. Kuch zamane tak woh yunhi rahe lekin phir jabke unhon ne sartabi aur rogardani ki, ahkam-e-Ilahi be-parwahi se taal diye to un par zor ka sailab aaya aur tamam mulk, baghat aur khetiyan waghera takht-o-taraj ho gayin. Jis ki tafseel yeh hai. Rasool Allah (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) se sawal hua ke Saba kisi aurat ka naam hai ya mard ka ya jagah ka? To aap (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne farmaya yeh ek mard tha jis ke das larkay thay jin mein se chhay to Yaman mein ja basay thay aur char Sham mein. Madhhaj, Kinda, Azd, Ash'ari, Aghar, Hamyariya yeh chhay qabeelay Yaman mein. Lakhm, Judham, Amila aur Ghassan yeh char qabeelay Sham mein. (Musnad-e-Ahmad). Farwa bin Musaik farmate hain main ne Rasool Allah (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) se poocha ke main apni qaum mein se manne walon aur aagay barhne walon ko le kar na manne aur peeche hatne walon se laron? Aap (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne farmaya haan. Jab main jaane laga to aap (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne mujhe bula kar farmaya dekho pehle unhein Islam ki dawat dena, na manen tab jihad ki tayari karna. Main ne kaha Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) yeh Saba kis ka naam hai? To aap (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ka jawab taqreeban wahi hai jo oopar mazkoor hua. Is mein yeh bhi hai ke qabeela Anmar mein se Bajila aur Khath'am bhi hain. Ek aur mutawwal riwayat mein is aayat ke shaan-e-nuzool ke mutaliq is ke sath yeh bhi hai ke Hazrat Farwa (R.A) ne Aan-Hazrat (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) se kaha tha ke Ya Rasool Allah (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) jahiliyat ke zamane mein qaum-e-Saba ki izzat thi, mujhe ab un ke irtidad ka khauf hai. Agar aap ijazat dein to main un se jihad karoon. Aap (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne farmaya un ke bare mein mujhe koi hukm nahin diya gaya. Pas yeh aayat utri. Lekin is mein gharabat hai, is se to yeh paya jata hai ke yeh aayat Madani hai, halankeh soorat Makkiya hai. Muhammad bin Ishaq Saba ka nasab-nama is tarah bayan karte hain: Abd-e-Shams bin Yashjub bin Ya'rub bin Qahtan. Isay Saba is liye kehte hain ke us ne sab se pehle Arab mein dushman ko qaid karne ka riwaj dala. Is wajah se isay Ra'ish bhi kehte hain. Maal ko Reesh aur Riyash bhi Arabi mein kehte hain. Yeh bhi mazkoor hai ke is badshah ne Aan-Hazrat (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ke tashreef lane se pehle hi aap (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ki pesh-goi ki thi ke mulk ka malik hamare baad ek Nabi hoga jo Haram ki izzat kare ga. Is ke baad us ke khalifa honge, jin ke samne duniya ke badshah sar-nigoon ho jayenge, phir hum mein bhi badshahat aayegi aur Banu Qahtan ke ek Nabi bhi honge. Us Nabi ka naam Ahmad hoga (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam). Kash ke main bhi un ki nabuwat ke zamane ko pa leta to har tarah ki khidmat ko ghaneemat samajhta. Logo jab bhi Allah ke woh Rasool (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) zahir hon to tum par farz hai ke un ka sath do aur un ke madadgar ban jao aur jo bhi aap (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) se mile us par meri janib se farz hai ke woh aap (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ki khidmat mein mera salam pahuncha de.

(Aqeel Hamdani) Qahtan ke bare mein teen qaul hain. Ek yeh ke woh Aram bin Sam bin Nooh ki nasl mein se hai. Dusra yeh ke woh Aabir yani Hazrat Hood (A.S) ki nasl mein se hai. Teesra yeh ke Hazrat Ismail bin Ibrahim (Alaihima-us-Salam) ki nasl se hai. Is sab ko tafseel ke sath Hafiz Abdul Barr (R.H) ne apni kitab Al-Anbah mein zikr kiya hai. Baaz riwayaton mein jo aaya hai ke Saba Arab mein se thay, is ka matlab yeh hai ke un logon mein se jin ki nasl se Arab huay. Un ka nasl-e-Ibrahimi mein se hona mashhoor nahin. Wallahu A'lam. Sahih Bukhari mein hai ke qabeela Aslam jab teeron se nishana bazi kar rahe thay aur Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) un ke paas niklay to Aap (ﷺ) ne farmaya: "Aye aulad-e-Ismail! Teer-andazi kiye jao, tumhare walid bhi pooray teer-andaz thay." Is se to maloom hota hai ke Saba ka silsila-e-nasab Khalil-ur-Rahman (A.S) tak pahunchta hai. Aslam Ansar ka ek qabeela tha aur Ansar saray ke saray Ghassan mein se hain aur yeh sab Yamani thay, Saba ki aulad hain. Yeh log Madine mein us waqt aaye jab sailab se un ka watan tabah ho gaya. Ek jamaat yahin aa kar basi thi, dusri Sham chali gayi. Inhein Ghassani is liye kehte hain ke is naam ki pani wali ek jagah par yeh thehray thay. Yeh bhi kaha gaya hai ke yeh Mishaal ke qareeb hai. Hazrat Hassan bin Thabit (R.A) ke sher se yeh bhi sabit hota hai ke ek pani wali jagah ya us kuanay ka naam Ghassan tha. Yeh jo Huzoor (ﷺ) ne farmaya ke us ki das auladein thin, is se murad sulbi auladein nahin kyunke baaz baaz do do teen teen naslon baad ke bhi hain, jaise ke kutub-e-ansab mein majood hai. Jo Sham aur Yaman mein ja kar abad huay, yeh bhi sailab ke aanay ke baad ka zikr hai. Baaz wahin rahay, baaz idhar udhar chalay gaye. Deewar ka qissa yeh hai ke un ke dono janib pahar thay, jahan se nehrein aur chashmay beh beh kar un ke shehron mein aatay thay, isi tarah naalay aur darya bhi idhar udhar se aatay thay. Un ke qadeemi badshahon mein se kisi ne un dono paharon ke darmiyan ek mazboot pushta banwa diya tha, jis deewar ki wajah se pani idhar udhar ho gaya tha aur ba-surat-e-darya jaari raha karta tha, jis ke dono janib baghaat aur khetiyan laga di thin. Pani ki kasrat aur zameen ki umdagi ki wajah se yeh khitta bahut hi zarkhez aur hara bhara raha karta tha. Yahan tak ke Hazrat Qatada (R.A) ka bayan hai ke koi aurat apne sar par jhulli rakh kar chalti thi, kuch door jaanay tak phalon se woh jhulli bilkul bhar jati thi. Darakhton se phal khud-ba-khud jo jhartay thay woh is qadar kasrat se hotay thay ke hath se tornay ki haajat nahin parti thi. Yeh deewar Ma'rib mein thi, Sana'a se teen marahil par thi aur Sadd-e-Ma'rib ke naam se mashhoor thi. Aab-o-hawa ki umdagi, sehat, mizaj aur aitidal Inayat-e-Ilahiya se is tarah tha ke un ke han makkhi, machhar aur zehreeley janwar bhi nahin hotay thay. Yeh is liye tha ke woh log Allah ki tauheed ko maanein aur dil-o-jaan se us ki khuloos ke sath ibadat karein.

Yahan tak ke jo qoum teen teerah ho jaye to Arab mein unhein Sabaiyon ki misl sunate hain. Ikrama R.H un ka qissa bayan farmate hue kehte hain ke un mein ek kahina aur ek kahan tha jin ke paas jinat idhar udhar ki khabrein laya karte the. Us kahan ko kahin pata chal gaya ke is basti ki veerani ka zamana qareeb aa gaya hai aur yahan ke log halak hone wale hain. Tha yeh bada maldar, khusoosan jaidad bohat sari thi. Us ne socha ke mujhe kya karna chahiye aur in haveliyon aur makanat aur baghat ki nisbat kya intezam karna chahiye? Aakhir ek baat us ki samajh mein aa gayi, us ke susral ke log bohat sare the aur woh qabeela bhi jari hone ke ilawa maldar tha. Us ne apne ladke ko bulaya aur us se kaha suno kal log mere paas jama ho jayenge, main tujhe kisi kaam ko kahunga to inkar kar dena, main tujhe bura bhala kahunga to bhi mujhe meri galiyon ka jawab dena, main uth kar tujhe thappad marunga to bhi us ke jawab mein mujhe thappad marna. Us ne kaha abba ji mujh se yeh kaise ho sake ga? Kahan ne kaha tum nahin samajhte, ek aisa hi ahem mamla darpesh hai aur tumhein mera hukm maan lena chahiye. Us ne iqrar kiya. Dusre din jabke us ke paas us ke milne julne wale sab jama ho gaye, us ne apne is ladke se kisi kaam ko kaha, us ne saaf inkar kar diya. Us ne use galiyan dein to us ne bhi samne galiyan dein. Yeh gusse mein utha aur use mara, ladke ne bhi palat kar use peeta. Yeh aur ghazabnak hua aur kehne laga chhuri lao main to ise zibah karunga. Tamam log ghabra gaye, har chand samjhaya lekin yeh yahi kehta raha ke main to ise zibah karunga. Log daure bhage gaye aur ladke ke nanihal walon ko khabar ki, woh sab aa gaye. Awal to minat samajat ki, manwana chaha lekin yeh kab manta tha? Unhon ne kaha aap ise koi aur saza dijiye, is ke badle hamein jo ji chahe saza dijiye lekin us ne kaha main to ise latka kar baqaida apne hath se zibah karunga. Unhon ne kaha aisa aap nahin kar sakte, is se pehle hum aap ko maar dalenge.

Us ne kaha achha jab yahan tak baat pahunch gayi hai toh main aise shahar mein nahin rehna chahta jahan mere aur meri aulad ke darmiyan aur log padein, mujh se mere makanat, jaidaden aur zameenein khareed lo, main yahan se kahin aur chala jata hoon. Chunancha us ne sab kuch bech dala aur qeemat naqd wasool kar li. Jab is taraf se itminan ho gaya toh us ne apni qoum ko khabar kar di, suno azab Allah ka aa raha hai, zawal ka waqt qareeb pahunch chuka hai. Ab tum mein se jo mehnat kar ke lamba safar kar ke naye gharon ka aarzoo mand ho woh toh Oman chala jaye aur jo khane peene ka shauqeen ho woh Basra chala jaye aur jo mazedar khajooren baghat mein baith kar azadi se khana chahta ho woh Madine chala jaye. Qoum ko us ki baton ka yaqeen tha, jise jo jagah aur jo cheez pasand aayi woh usi taraf munh uthaye bhaga. Baaz Oman ki taraf, baaz Basra ki taraf, baaz Madine ki taraf. Is taraf teen qabeele chale thay, Aus aur Khazraj aur Banu Usman. Jab yeh log Batn-e-Marr mein pahunche toh Banu Usman ne kaha hamein toh yeh jagah bahut pasand hai, ab hum aage nahin jayenge. Chunancha yeh yahin bas gaye aur isi wajah se unhein Khuza'a kaha gaya, kyunke woh apne sathiyon se peeche reh gaye. Aus-o-Khazraj barabar Madine pahunche aur yahan aa kar qayam kiya. Yeh asar bhi ajeeb-o-ghareeb hai. Jis kahan (kahin) ka is mein zikr hai us ka naam Amra bin Aamir hai, yeh Yaman ka ek sardar tha aur Saba ke bade logon mein se tha aur un ka kahan tha. Seerat-e-Ibn-e-Ishaq mein hai ke sab se pehle yahi Yaman se nikla tha, is liye ke Sadd-e-Marib ko khokhla karte hue us ne chuhon ko dekh liya tha aur samajh gaya tha ke ab Yaman ki khair nahin, yeh deewar giri aur sailab sab kuch teh-o-bala karega, toh us ne apne sab se chhote ladke ko woh makr sikhaya jis ka zikr oopar guzra. Us waqt us ne gusse mein kaha ke main aise shahar mein rehna pasand nahin karta, main apni jaidaden aur zameenein isi waqt bechta hoon. Logon ne kaha Amro ke is gusse ko ghaneemat jaano, chunancha sasta mehnga sab kuch bech dala aur farigh ho kar chal pada. Qabeela Asad bhi us ke sath ho liya. Raste mein Akka un se lade, barabar barabar ki ladai rahi, jis ka zikr Abbas bin Mirdas Al-Sulami (R.A) ke sher'on mein bhi hai. Phir yeh yahan se chal kar mukhtalif shahron mein pahunch gaye. Aal-e-Jafna bin Amro bin Aamir Shaam mein gaye, Aus-o-Khazraj Madine mein, Khuza'a Marr mein, Azd-e-Sarat Sarat mein, Azd-e-Oman Oman mein. Yahan sailab aaya jis ne Marib ke band ko tod diya. Suddi ne is qisse mein bayan kiya hai ke us ne apne muqable ke liye apne bete ko nahin balkay bhatije ko kaha tha. Baaz ahl-e-ilm ka bayan hai ke us ki aurat jis ka naam Tareeqa tha, us ne apni kahanat se yeh baat maloom kar ke sab ko batayi thi aur riwayat mein hai ke Oman mein Ghassani aur Azd bhi halak kar diye gaye.

Meethay aur thanday paani ki rail-peil, phalon aur kheiton ki beshumar rozi ke bawajood Sail-e-Arim se yeh halat ho gayi ke ek-ek luqmay ko aur ek-ek boond paani ko taras gaye. Yeh pakar aur azaab, yeh tangi aur saza jo unhein pahunchi, is se har sabir-o-shakir ibrat hasil kar sakta hai ke Allah ki nafarmaniyan kis tarah insaan ko gher leti hain, aafiyat ko hata kar aafat ko le aati hain. Musibaton par sabr, nematon par shukr karne walay is mein dalail-e-qudrat payenge. Rasool Allah (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) farmatay hain, Allah Ta'ala ne momin ke liye ta'ajjub-naak faisla kiya hai; agar usay rahat milay aur yeh shukr karay to ajar paye aur agar usay museebat pahunchay aur sabr karay to ajar paye. Garz momin ko har halat par ajar-o-sawab milta hai, us ka har kaam nek hai. Yahan tak ke mohabbat ke sath jo luqma utha kar yeh apni biwi ke munh mein de, us par bhi usay sawab milta hai (Musnad-e-Ahmad). Bukhari-o-Muslim mein hai, Aap (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) farmatay hain, ta'ajjub hai ke momin ke liye Allah Ta'ala ki har qaza bhalai ke liye hi hoti hai. Agar usay rahat aur khushi pahunchti hai to shukr kar ke bhalai hasil karta hai aur agar burai aur gham pahunchta hai to yeh sabr karta hai aur badla hasil karta hai. Yeh nemat to sirf momin ko hi hasil hai ke jis ki har halat behtari aur bhalai wali hai. Hazrat Mutarrif (R.H) farmatay hain, sabr-o-shukranay wala banda kitna hi achha hai ke jab usay nemat milay to shukr karay aur jab zehmat pahunchay to sabr karay.

Har har manzil par pukhta mazedar taaze mewey khushgawar meetha pani majood, har raat ko kisi basti mein guzar lein aur rahat-o-aaram, amn-o-aman se jayein aayein. Kehte hain ke yeh bastiyan Sana'a ke qurb-o-jawar mein thin, ba'ad ki dusri qira'at ba'adahu. Iblees aur us ka azm. Saba ke qisse ke bayan ke baad Shaitan ke aur mureedon ka aam taur par zikr farmata hai ke woh hidayat ke badle zalalat, bhalai ke badle burai le lete hain. Iblees ne randa-e-dargah ho kar jo kaha tha ke main in ki aulad ko har tarah barbad karne ki koshish karunga aur thodi si jamaat ke siwa baqi sab logon ko teri seedhi rah se bhatka dunga. Us ne yeh kar dikhaya aur aulad-e-Adam ko apne panje mein phans liya. Jab Hazrat Adam-o-Hawa (A.S) apni khata ki wajah se jannat se utar diye gaye aur Iblees-e-La'een bhi un ke sath utra us waqt woh bahut khush tha aur jee mein itra raha tha ke jab inhein main ne behka liya to in ki aulad ko tabah kar dena to mere bayein hath ka khel hai. Is khabeeth ka qaul tha ke main Ibn-e-Adam ko sabz bagh dikhata rahunga, ghaflat mein rakhunga. Tarah tarah se dhoke dunga aur apne jaal mein phansaye rakhunga. Jis ke jawab mein Janab-e-Bari Jalla Jalaluhu ne farmaya tha mujhe bhi apni izzat ki qasam maut ke gharghare se pehle jab kabhi woh tauba karega main foran qabool kar lunga. Woh mujhe jab pukarega main us ki taraf mutawajja ho jaunga. Mujh se jab kabhi jo kuch mange ga main use dunga. Mujh se jab woh bakhshish talab karega main use bakhsh dunga. (Ibn-e-Abi Hatim), is ka koi ghalba, hujjat, zabardasti, maar-peet insan par na thi. Sirf dhoka, fareb aur makr-bazi thi jis mein yeh sab phans gaye. Is mein hikmat-e-Ilahi yeh thi ke momin-o-kafir zahir ho jayen. Hujjat-e-Allah khatam ho jaye, aakhirat ko manne wale Shaitan ki nahin manenge. Is ke munkir Rahman ki itteba nahin karenge. Allah har cheez par nigahban hai. Mominon ki jamaat us ki hifazat ka sahara leti hai is liye Iblees un ka kuch bigad nahin sakta aur kafiron ki jamaat khud Allah ko chhod deti hai is liye un par se Allah ki nigahbani hat jati hai aur woh Shaitan ke har fareb ka shikar ban jate hain.

Wahdahu La-Sharika bayan ho raha hai ke Allah akela hai, Wahid hai, Ahad hai, Fard hai, Samad hai, us ke siwa koi mabood nahin woh be-nazeer, la-sharik aur be-maseel hai, us ka koi sharik nahin, sathi nahin, musheer nahin, wazeer nahin, madadgar-o-pesh-e-ban nahin. Phir zid karne wala aur khilaf kehne wala kahan? Jin jin ko pukara karte woh pukar kar dekh lo maloom ho jayega ke ek zarre ke bhi mukhtar nahin. Mahaz be-bas aur bilkul mohtaj-o-aajiz hain, na zameeniyon mein un ki kuch chale na aasmanon mein jaise aur aayat mein hai ke woh ek khajoor ke chhalke ke bhi malik nahin aur yehi nahin ke unhein khud ikhtiyari hukumat na ho na sahi shirkat ke tor par hi ho nahin shirkat ke tor par bhi nahin. Na Allah Ta'ala un se apne kisi kaam mein madad leta hai. Balkeh yeh sab ke sab faqeer mohtaj hain us ke dar ke ghulam aur us ke bande hain, us ki azmat-o-kibriyai izzat-o-badai aisi hai ke baghair us ki ijazat ke kisi ki jurrat nahin ke us ke samne kisi ki sifarish baghair us ki razamandi ke baghair kar sake aur aayat mein hai (Wa kam min malakin fis-samawati la tughni shafa'atuhum shai'an illa min ba'di an ya'zanal-lahu liman yasha'u wa yarda) (Surah (An-Najm: 26), yani aasmanon ke kul farishtay bhi us ke samne kisi ki sifarish ke liye lab hila nahin sakte magar jis ke liye Allah apni razamandi se ijazat de de. Ek aur jagah farman hai (Wa la yashfa'una illa limanirtada wa hum min khashyatihi mushfiqun) (Surah (Al-Anbiya: 28), woh log sirf un ki shafa'at kar sakte hain jin ke liye Allah ki razamandi ho woh to khud hi us ke khauf se tharra rahe hain. Tamam aulad-e-Adam ke sardar sab se bade shafee aur safarishi Hazrat Muhammad Rasulullah (ﷺ) bhi jab Qayamat ke din Maqam-e-Mahmood mein shafa'at ke liye tashreef le aayenge ke Allah Ta'ala aaye aur makhlooq ke faisle kare us waqt ki nisbat aap farmate hain main Allah ke samne sajde mein gir padunga Allah janta hai ke kab tak sajde mein pada rahunga us sajde mein is qadar apne Rab ki tareefein bayan karunga ke us waqt to woh alfaaz bhi mujhe maloom nahin. Phir mujh se kaha jayega ae Muhammad (ﷺ) apna sar uthaiye aap baat kijiye aap ki baat suni jayegi aap mangiye aap ko diya jayega. Aap shafa'at kijiye qabool ki jayegi. Rab ki azmat ka ek aur maqam bayan ho raha hai ke jab woh apni wahi mein kalam karta hai aur aasmanon ke muqarrab farishtay usay sunte hain to haibat se kanp uthte hain aur ghashi wale ki tarah ho jate hain jab un ke dilon se ghabrahat hat jati hai. Faza' ki dusri qira'at faragh bhi aayi hai matlab dono ka ek hai. To ab aapas mein ek dusre se daryaft karte hain ke us waqt Rab ka kya hukum nazil hua? Pas Ahl-e-Arsh apne paas walon ko woh apne paas walon ko yunhi darja badarja hukum pahuncha dete hain bila kam-o-kast theek theek isi tarah pahuncha dete hain. Ek matlab is aayat ka yeh bhi bayan kiya gaya hai ke jab sakrat ka waqt aata hai.

Is waqt mushrik yeh kehte hain aur isi tarah Qayamat ke din bhi jab apni ghaflat se chaunkain ge aur hosh-o-hawas qaim ho jayain ge us waqt yeh kahain ge ke tumhare Rab ne kya farmaya? Jawab mile ga ke haq farmaya, haq farmaya aur jis cheez se duniya mein be-fikr thay aaj us ke samne pesh kar di jaye gi. Toh dilon se ghabrahat door kiye jane ke yeh ma'ani huye ke jab aankhon par se parda utha diya jaye ga us waqt sab shak-o-takzeeb alag ho jayain ge. Shaitani wasawas door ho jayain ge us waqt Rab ke wadon ki haqaniyat tasleem karain ge aur us ki bulandi aur barai ke qail hon ge. Pas na toh maut ke waqt ka iqrar nafa de na Qayamat ke maidan ka iqrar faida pohanchaye. Lekin Imam Ibn-e-Jarir (R.H) ke nazdeek pehli tafseer hi rajeh hai yani murad is se farishtay hain aur yahi theek bhi hai aur is ki ta'eed ahadees-o-asar se bhi hoti hai. Sahih Bukhari Shareef mein is ayat ki tafseer ke mauqa par hai ke jab Allah Ta'ala kisi amr ka faisla aasman mein karta hai toh farishtay aajizi ke sath apne par jhuka lete hain aur Rab ka kalam aisa waqay hota hai jaise us zanjeer ki aawaz jo pathar par bajai jati ho jab haibat kam ho jati hai. Toh poochte hain ke tumhare Rab ne is waqt kya farmaya? Jawab milta hai ke jo farmaya haq hai aur woh Aala-o-Kabeer hai. Ba'az martaba aisa hota hai ke jo jinat farishton ki batain sunne ki gharz se gaye huye hain aur jo teh-ba-teh ek dusron ke upar hain woh koi kalma sun lete hain upar wala neeche wale ko woh apne se neeche wale ko suna deta hai aur woh kahinon ke kanon tak pohancha dete hain. Un ke peeche foran un ke jalane ko aag ka shola lapakta hai lekin kabhi kabhi toh woh us ke aane se pehle hi ek dusre ko pohancha deta hai aur kabhi pohanchane se pehle hi jala diya jata hai. Kahin us ek kalme ke sath sau jhoot mila kar logon mein phailata hai. Woh ek baat sachi nikalti hai log us ke mureed ban jate hain ke dekho yeh baat us ke kehne ke mutabiq hi hui. Musnad mein hai Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ek martaba Sahaba (R.A) ke paas baithe huye thay ke ek sitara toota aur zabardast roshni ho gayi. Aap (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne daryaft farmaya ke jahiliyat mein tumhara khayal in sitaron ke tootne ki nisbat kya tha? Unhon ne kaha hum is mauqa par samajhte thay ke ya toh koi bohat bada aadmi paida hua ya mara. Zuhri se sawal hua ke kya jahiliyat ke zamane mein bhi sitaray jharte thay? Kaha haan lekin kam. Aap (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ki ba'asat ke zamane se in mein bohat ziyadati ho gayi. Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne farmaya suno inhein kisi ki maut-o-hayat se koi wasta nahin. Baat yeh hai ke jab hamara Rab Tabarak-o-Ta'ala kisi amr ka aasmanon mein faisla karta hai toh hamilan-e-Arsh us ki tasbeeh bayan karte hain phir saatwein aasman wale phir chhatay aasman wale yahan tak ke yeh tasbeeh aasman-e-duniya tak pohanchti hai. Phir Arsh ke aas-paas ke farishtay Arsh ke uthane wale farishton se poochte hain ke Allah Ta'ala ne kya farmaya?

Woh unhein batate hain phir har neeche wala upar wale se daryaft karta hai aur woh use batata hai yahan tak ke aasman-e-awwal walon ko khabar pahunchti hai. Kabhi uchak le jaane wale jinnaat use sun lete hain toh un par yeh sitare jharte hain taham jo baat Allah ko pahunchani manzoor hoti hai use woh le urte hain aur us ke sath bahut kuch baatil aur jhoot mila kar logon mein shohrat dete hain. Ibn-e-Abi Hatim mein hai Allah Ta'ala jab apne kisi amr-e-ilahi ki wahi karta hai toh aasman maare khauf ke kapkapa uthte hain aur farishte haibat-zada ho kar sajde mein gir padte hain. Sab se pehle Hazrat Jibraeel (A.S) sar uthate hain aur Allah ka farman sunte hain phir un ki zabani aur farishte sunte hain aur woh kehte jaate hain ke Allah ne haq farmaya woh bulandi aur badai wala hai. Yahan tak ke woh Allah ka ameen farishta jis ki taraf ho use pahuncha deta hai. Hazrat Ibn-e-Abbas (R.A) aur Qatadah (R.H) se marwi hai ke yeh us wahi ka zikr hai jo Hazrat Isa (A.S) ke baad nabiyon ke na hone ke zamane mein band reh kar phir ibtida Khatam-ul-Mursaleen (ﷺ) par nazil hui. Haqeeqat yeh hai ke is ibtidai wahi ke bhi is aayat ke taht mein dakhil hone mein koi shak nahin lekin aayat is ko aur sab ko shamil hai.))

Wahdahu La-Sharika bayan ho raha hai ke Allah akela hai, Wahid hai, Ahad hai, Fard hai, Samad hai, us ke siwa koi mabood nahin woh be-nazeer, la-sharik aur be-maseel hai, us ka koi sharik nahin, sathi nahin, musheer nahin, wazeer nahin, madadgar-o-pesh-e-ban nahin. Phir zid karne wala aur khilaf kehne wala kahan? Jin jin ko pukara karte woh pukar kar dekh lo maloom ho jayega ke ek zarre ke bhi mukhtar nahin. Mahaz be-bas aur bilkul mohtaj-o-aajiz hain, na zameeniyon mein un ki kuch chale na aasmanon mein jaise aur aayat mein hai ke woh ek khajoor ke chhalke ke bhi malik nahin aur yehi nahin ke unhein khud ikhtiyari hukumat na ho na sahi shirkat ke tor par hi ho nahin shirkat ke tor par bhi nahin. Na Allah Ta'ala un se apne kisi kaam mein madad leta hai. Balkeh yeh sab ke sab faqeer mohtaj hain us ke dar ke ghulam aur us ke bande hain, us ki azmat-o-kibriyai izzat-o-badai aisi hai ke baghair us ki ijazat ke kisi ki jurrat nahin ke us ke samne kisi ki sifarish baghair us ki razamandi ke baghair kar sake aur aayat mein hai (Wa kam min malakin fis-samawati la tughni shafa'atuhum shai'an illa min ba'di an ya'zanal-lahu liman yasha'u wa yarda) (Surah (An-Najm: 26), yani aasmanon ke kul farishtay bhi us ke samne kisi ki sifarish ke liye lab hila nahin sakte magar jis ke liye Allah apni razamandi se ijazat de de. Ek aur jagah farman hai (Wa la yashfa'una illa limanirtada wa hum min khashyatihi mushfiqun) (Surah (Al-Anbiya: 28), woh log sirf un ki shafa'at kar sakte hain jin ke liye Allah ki razamandi ho woh to khud hi us ke khauf se tharra rahe hain. Tamam aulad-e-Adam ke sardar sab se bade shafee aur safarishi Hazrat Muhammad Rasulullah (ﷺ) bhi jab Qayamat ke din Maqam-e-Mahmood mein shafa'at ke liye tashreef le aayenge ke Allah Ta'ala aaye aur makhlooq ke faisle kare us waqt ki nisbat aap farmate hain main Allah ke samne sajde mein gir padunga Allah janta hai ke kab tak sajde mein pada rahunga us sajde mein is qadar apne Rab ki tareefein bayan karunga ke us waqt to woh alfaaz bhi mujhe maloom nahin. Phir mujh se kaha jayega ae Muhammad (ﷺ) apna sar uthaiye aap baat kijiye aap ki baat suni jayegi aap mangiye aap ko diya jayega. Aap shafa'at kijiye qabool ki jayegi. Rab ki azmat ka ek aur maqam bayan ho raha hai ke jab woh apni wahi mein kalam karta hai aur aasmanon ke muqarrab farishtay usay sunte hain to haibat se kanp uthte hain aur ghashi wale ki tarah ho jate hain jab un ke dilon se ghabrahat hat jati hai. Jaise un logon ko is ka iqrar hai ke aasman se barishein barsane wala aur zameeno se anaaj ugane wala sirf Allah Ta'ala hi hai aise hi unhein yeh bhi maan lena chahiye ke ibadat ke laiq bhi faqat wahi hai. Phir farmata hai ke jab hum tum mein itna bada ikhtilaf hai to lamahala ek hidayat par aur dusra zalalat par hai, nahin ho sakta ke dono fareeq hidayat par hon ya dono zalalat par hon. Hum muwahid hain aur tauheed ke dalail khulam khula hain aur wazeh hum bayan kar chuke hain aur tum shirk par ho jis ki koi daleel tumhare paas nahin. Pas yaqeenan hum hidayat par aur yaqeenan tum zalalat par ho. Ashab-e-Rasool (ﷺ) ne mushrikon se yahi kaha tha ke hum fareeqain mein se ek zaroor sacha hai. Kyunke is qadar tazad-o-tabayan ke baad dono ka sacha hona to aqlan mahal hai. Is aayat ke ek ma'ani yeh bhi bayan kiye gaye hain ke hum hi hidayat par aur tum zalalat par ho, hamara tumhara bilkul koi talluq nahin. Hum tum se aur tumhare a'maal se bari-uz-zimma hain. Haan jis raah hum chal rahe hain isi raah par tum bhi aa jao to beshak tum hamare ho aur hum tumhare hain warna hum tum mein koi talluq nahin aur ek aayat mein bhi hai ke agar yeh tujhe jhutlayein to keh de ke mera amal mere saath hai aur tumhara amal tumhare saath hai, tum mere a'maal se chidte ho aur main tumhare kartoot se bezar hoon. Nekon ko un ki jaza aur badon ko un ki saza dega. Us din tumhein hamari haqaniyat-o-sadaqat maloom ho jaye gi. Jaise irshad hai (Wa yauma taqumus sa'atu yauma'izin yatafarraqoon) (Surah (Ar-Rum: 14). Qayamat ke din sab juda juda ho jayenge. Imaan-dar jannat ke paak baghon mein khush-waqt-o-farhan honge aur hamari aayaton aur aakhirat ke din ko jhutlane wale, kufr karne wale, dozakh ke garhon mein hairan-o-pareshan honge. Woh Hakim-o-Adil hai, haqeeqat-e-haal ka poora aalim hai, tum apne in maboodon ko zara mujhe bhi to dikhao. Lekin kahan se suboot de sakoge. Jaise un logon ko is ka iqrar hai ke aasman se barishein barsane wala aur zameeno se anaaj ugane wala sirf Allah Ta'ala hi hai aise hi unhein yeh bhi maan lena chahiye ke ibadat ke laiq bhi faqat wahi hai. Phir farmata hai ke jab hum tum mein itna bada ikhtilaf hai to lamahala ek hidayat par aur dusra zalalat par hai, nahin ho sakta ke dono fareeq hidayat par hon ya dono zalalat par hon. Hum muwahid hain aur tauheed ke dalail khulam khula hain aur wazeh hum bayan kar chuke hain aur tum shirk par ho jis ki koi daleel tumhare paas nahin. Pas yaqeenan hum hidayat par aur yaqeenan tum zalalat par ho. Ashab-e-Rasool (ﷺ) ne mushrikon se yahi kaha tha ke hum fareeqain mein se ek zaroor sacha hai. Kyunke is qadar tazad-o-tabayan ke baad dono ka sacha hona to aqlan mahal hai. Is aayat ke ek ma'ani yeh bhi bayan kiye gaye hain ke hum hi hidayat par aur tum zalalat par ho, hamara tumhara bilkul koi talluq nahin. Hum tum se aur tumhare a'maal se bari-uz-zimma hain. Haan jis raah hum chal rahe hain isi raah par tum bhi aa jao to beshak tum hamare ho aur hum tumhare hain warna hum tum mein koi talluq nahin aur ek aayat mein bhi hai ke agar yeh tujhe jhutlayein to keh de ke mera amal mere saath hai aur tumhara amal tumhare saath hai, tum mere a'maal se chidte ho aur main tumhare kartoot se bezar hoon. Surah (Qul ya ayyuhal kafirun) al-kh, mein bhi isi be-talluqi aur bara'at ka zikr hai, Rabb-ul-Aalameen tamam aalam ko maidan-e-Qayamat mein ikatha kar ke sachay faislay kar dega. Nekon ko un ki jaza aur badon ko un ki saza dega. Us din tumhein hamari haqaniyat-o-sadaqat maloom ho jaye gi. Jaise irshad hai (Wa yauma taqumus sa'atu yauma'izin yatafarraqoon) (Surah (Ar-Rum: 14). Qayamat ke din sab juda juda ho jayenge. Imaan-dar jannat ke paak baghon mein khush-waqt-o-farhan honge aur hamari aayaton aur aakhirat ke din ko jhutlane wale, kufr karne wale, dozakh ke garhon mein hairan-o-pareshan honge. Woh Hakim-o-Adil hai, haqeeqat-e-haal ka poora aalim hai, tum apne in maboodon ko zara mujhe bhi to dikhao. Lekin kahan se suboot de sakoge. Jabke mera Rabb la-nazeer, be-shareek aur adeem-ul-maseel hai, woh akela hai, woh zi-izzat hai jis ne sab ko apne qabze mein kar rakha hai aur har ek par ghalib aa gaya hai. Hakim hai apne aqwal-o-af'aal mein. Is tarah shariat aur taqdeer mein bhi barkaton wala, bulandiyon wala, paak munazza aur mushrikon ki tamam tohmaton se alag hai.)

Tamam aqwam ke liye nabuwat. Allah Ta'ala apne bande aur apne Rasool Hazrat Muhammad (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) se farma raha hai ke hum ne tujhe tamam kainat ki taraf apna Rasool bana kar bheja hai. Jaise aur jagah hai (Qul ya ayyuhan-nasu inni Rasoolullahi ilaikum jami'a) (Surah (Al-A'raf: 158) yani elaan kar do ke ae logo main tum sab ki taraf Allah ka Rasool hoon aur aayat mein hai (Tabarakallazi nazzalal-furqana 'ala 'abdihi liyakuna lil-'alamina nazira) (Surah (Al-Furqan: 1) babarakat hai woh Allah jis ne apne bande par Quran nazil farmaya taake woh tamam jahan ko hoshiyar kar de. Yeh bhi farmaya ke "ita'at guzaron ko basharat jannat ki de aur nafarmanon ko khabar jahannam ki. Lekin aksar log apni jahalat se Nabi ki nabuwat ko nahin maante" jaise farmaya (Wa ma aksarun-nasi wa lau harasta bimu'minin) (Surah (Yusuf: 103) go tu har chand chahe taham aksar log be-imaan rahenge. Ek aur jagah irshad hua "agar badi jama'at ki baat maane ga to woh khud tujhe rah-e-rast se hata denge. Pas Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ki risalat aam logon ki taraf thi. Arab-o-Ajam sab ki taraf se Allah ko zyada pyara woh hai jo sab se zyada us ka taabi'-e-farman ho. Hazrat Ibn Abbas (R.A) farmate hain Allah Ta'ala ne Hazrat Muhammad (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ko aasman walon aur nabiyon par garz sab par fazilat di hai. Logon ne is ki daleel daryaft ki to aap ne farmaya dekho Quran farmata hai ke har Rasool ko us ki qoum ki zaban ke sath bheja taake woh is mein khulam khula tabligh kar de aur Aan-Hazrat (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ki nisbat farmata hai ke hum ne tujhe aam logon ki taraf apna Rasool bana kar bheja. Bukhari Muslim mein farman-e-Risalat Ma'ab (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) hai ke mujhe paanch sifatein aisi di gayi hain jo mujh se pehle kisi Nabi (A.S) ko nahin di gayin. Mahina bhar ki rah tak meri madad sirf ra'ab se ki gayi hai. Mere liye sari zameen masjid aur paak banayi gayi hai. Meri ummat mein se jis kisi ko jis jagah namaz ka waqt aa jaye woh usi jagah namaz padh le. Mujh se pehle kisi Nabi ke liye ghanimat ka maal halal nahin kiya gaya tha. Mere liye ghanimat halal kar di gayi. Mujhe shafa'at di gayi. Har Nabi sirf apni qoum ki taraf bheja jata tha aur main tamam logon ki taraf bheja gaya aur hadith mein hai siyah-o-surkh sab ki taraf main Nabi bana kar bheja gaya hoon. Yani jinn-o-ins Arab-o-Ajam ki taraf, phir kafiron ka Qayamat ko muhaal manna bayan ho raha hai ke puchte hain Qayamat kab aayegi? Jaise aur jagah hai be-imaan to is ki jaldi macha rahe hain aur ba-imaan is se kapkapa rahe hain aur ise haq jante hain. Jawab deta hai ke tumhare liye wa'ade ka din muqarrar ho chuka hai jis mein taqdeer-o-ta'akhir, kami-o-ziyadati namumkin hai. Jaise farmaya (Inna ajalallahi iza ja'a la yu'akhkhar, lau kuntum ta'lamun) (Surah (Nuh: 4) aur farmaya (Wa ma nu'akh-khiru-hu illa li-ajalim-ma'dud) (Surah (Hud: 104) yani woh muqarrara waqt peeche hatne ka nahin.

Tumhein us waqt-e-muqarrara tak dheel hai, jab woh din aa gaya phir toh koi lab bhi na hila sake ga, us din ba'az nek bakht honge aur ba'az badbakht.)))))

Kafiron ki sarkashi. Kafiron ki sarkashi aur batil ki zid ka bayan ho raha hai ke unhon ne faisla kar liya hai ke woh Quran ki haqaniyat ki hazarha daleelein bhi dekh lein lekin nahin manenge. Balkeh is se agli kitab par bhi iman nahin layenge. Unhein apne is qaul ka maza us waqt aayega jab Allah ke samne jahannam ke kinare khade chhote badon ko, bade chhoton ko ilzam denge. Har ek dusre ko qasoorwar thahrayega. Tabedar apne sardaron se kahenge ke tum hamein na rokte toh hum zaroor iman laye huye hote, un ke buzurg unhein jawab denge ke kya hum ne tumhein roka tha? Hum ne ek baat kahi tum jante the ke yeh sab bedaleel hai dusri janib se daleelon ki barasti hui barish tumhari aankhon ke samne thi phir tum ne is ki pairwi chhod kar hamari kyun maan li? Yeh toh tumhari apni be-aqli thi, tum khud shahwat parast the, tumhare apne dil Allah ki baton se bhagte the, rasoolon ki tabedari khud tumhari tabiyaton par shaaq guzarti thi. Sara qasoor tumhara apna hi hai hamein kya ilzam de rahe ho? Apne buzurgon ki maan lene wale yeh bedaleel unhein phir jawab denge ke tumhari din raat ki dhoke baziyan, jaal saziyan, fareb kariyan hamein itminan dilatin ke hamare afaal aur aqaid theek hain, hum se baar baar shirk-o-kufr ke na chhodne, purane deen ke na badalne, baap dadon ki raush par qaim rahne ko kahna, hamari kamar thap-kana. Hamare iman se ruk jane ka yahi sabab hua. Tum hi aa aa kar hamein aqli dhakosle suna kar Islam se rugardan karte the. Donon ilzam bhi denge. Barat bhi karenge. Lekin dil mein apne kiye par pachhta rahe honge. In sab ke hathon ko gardan se mila kar tauq-o-zanjeer se jakad diya jayega. Ab har ek ko us ke aamal ke mutabiq badla milega. Gumrah karne walon ko bhi aur gumrah hone walon ko bhi. Har ek ko pura pura azab hoga. Rasool Allah (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) farmate hain jahannami jab hanka kar jahannam ke paas pahunchaye jayenge toh jahannam ke ek shole ki lapet se sare jism ka gosht jhulas kar pairon par aapdega. (Ibn Abi Hatim) Hasan bin Yahya Khushni farmate hain ke jahannam ke har qaid khane, har ghar, har zanjeer, har qaid par jahannami ka naam likha hua hai jab Hazrat Sulaiman Darani ke samne yeh bayan hua toh aap bahut roye aur farmane lage haye haye phir kya haal hoga us ka jis par yeh sab azab jama ho jayen. Pairon mein bediyan hon, hathon mein hathkadiyan hon, gardan mein tauq hon phir jahannam ke ghar mein dhakel diya jaye. Allah tu bachana parwardigar tu hamein salamat rakhna. Allahumma sallim Allahumma sallim.

Nabi-e-Akram (ﷺ) ke liye tasalliyan. Allah Ta'ala apne Nabi (ﷺ) ko tasalli deta hai aur agle paighambaron ki si seerat rakhne ko farmata hai. Hum tujh par kaise iman layein tere manne wale to sab neeche darje ke log hain. Yehi mazmoon dusri ayat (WAMA NARAKA ITTABA'AKA ILLA LLAZINA HUM ARAZILUNA BADIYAR RA'YI) (Surah (Hud: 27), mein hai. Qaum-e-Saleh ke mutakabbir log za'ifon se kehte hain (ATA'LAMUNA ANNA SALIHAN MURSALUM MIR RABBIHI QALU INNA BIMA URSILA BIHI MU'MINUN) (Surah (Al-A'raf: 75). Kya tumhein Hazrat Saleh (A.S) ke Nabi hone ka yaqeen hai? Unhon ne kaha haan hum to momin hain. To mutakabbireen ne saaf kaha ke hum nahin maante. Aur ayat mein hai (WAKAZALIKA FATANNA BA'DAHUM BIBA'DIN LIYAQULU AHA'ULA'I MANNALLAHU ALAIHIM MIM BAININA ALAISALLAHU BI A'LAMA BISH-SHAKIRIN) (Surah (Al-An'am: 53), yani isi tarah hum ne ek ko dusre se fitne mein dala taake woh kahein kya yehi log hain jin par Allah ne hum sab mein se ehsan kiya. Kya Allah shukarguzaron ko janne wala nahin? Aur farmaya har basti mein wahan ke bade log mujrim aur makkar hote hain aur farman hai (WAIZA ARADNA AN NUHLIKA QARYATAN AMARNA MUTRAFIHA FAFASAQU FIHA FAHAQQA ALAIHAL QAWLU FADAMMARNAHA TADMIRA) (Surah (Al-Isra: 16). Jab kisi basti ki halakat ka hum irada karte hain to us ke sarkash logon ko kuch ahkaam dete hain woh nahin maante phir hum unhein halak kar dete hain. Pas yahan bhi farmata hai ke hum ne jis basti mein koi Nabi aur Rasool bheja wahan ke jaah-o-hashmat, shaan-o-shaukat wale ra'ison, amiron, sardaron aur bade logon ne jhat apne kufr ka elaan kar diya. Ibn-e-Abi Hatim mein hai Abu Razin farmate hain ke do shakhs aapas mein shareek thay ek to samundar paar chala gaya, ek wahin raha jab Aan-Hazrat (ﷺ) mab'oos hue to us ne apne saathi se likh kar daryaft kiya ke Huzoor (ﷺ) ka kya haal hai? Us ne jawab mein likha ke gire pade logon ne us ki baat maani hai. Shareef Quraishiyon ne us ki ita'at nahin ki. Is khat ko parh kar woh apni tijarat chor chaar kar safar kar ke apne shareek ke paas pahuncha. Yeh parha likha aadmi tha, kitabon ka ilm use hasil tha. Us se poocha ke batao Huzoor (ﷺ) kahan hain? Maloom kar ke aap ki khidmat mein hazir hua aap se poocha ke aap logon ko kis cheez ki taraf bulate hain? Aap ne Islam ke arkaan us ke samne bayan farmaye. Woh use sunte hi iman le aaya. Aap ne farmaya tumhein is ki tasdeeq kyunkar ho gayi? Us ne kaha is baat se ke tamam ambiya ke ibtidai manne wale hamesha za'if maskeen log hi hote hain.

Is par yeh aayatein utrin aur Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne aadmi bhej kar un se kehwaya ke tumhari baat ki sachai Allah Ta'ala ne nazil farmayi. Isi tarah Heraclius ne kaha tha jab ke us ne Abu Sufyan se un ki jahiliyat ki halat mein Aan-Hazrat (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ki nisbat daryaft kiya tha ke kya shareef logon ne un ki tabedari ki hai ya zaeefon ne? To Abu Sufyan ne jawab diya ke zaeefon ne. Is par Heraclius ne kaha tha ke har Rasool ki awwalan tabedari karne wale yahi zaeef log hote hain, phir farmaya yeh khush-haal log maal-o-aulad ki kasrat par hi fakhr karte hain aur ise is baat ki daleel banate hain ke woh pasandida hain Allah ke. Agar Allah ki khaas inayat-o-meharbani un par na hoti to unhein yeh ne'matein na deta aur jab yahan Rabb-e-Meharban hai to aakhirat mein bhi woh meharban hi rahega. Quran ne har jagah is ka radd kiya hai, ek jagah farmaya (A-yahsabuna annama numidduhum bihi min-maliw-wa-banin) (Surah (Al-Mu'minun: 55) kya un ka khayal hai ke maal-o-aulad ki aksariyat un ke liye behtar hai? Nahin balkay burai hai lekin yeh beshoor hain. Ek aur aayat mein hai (Wala tu'jibka amwaluhum wa-auladuhum innama yuridullahu ay-yu'azzibahum biha fid-dunya wa-tazhaqa anfusuhum wahum kafirun) (Surah (At-Tawbah: 85) un ki maal-o-aulad tujhe dhoke mein na daale, is se unhein dunya mein bhi saza hogi aur marte dam tak yeh kufr par hi rahenge. Aur aayaton mein hai (Zarni waman khalaqtu wahida) (Surah (Al-Muddaththir: 11) yani mujhe aur us shakhs ko chhod de jise bahut se farzand de rakhe hain aur har tarah ka aish us ke liye muhayya kar diya hai. Taham use tama' hai ke main aur zyada doon. Aisa nahin, yeh hamari aayaton ka mukhalif hai. Zamana jaanta hai ke ise main dozakh ke pahadon par chadhaunga. Is shakhs ka waqia bhi mazkoor hua hai jis ke do baagh thay, maal wala, phalon wala, aulad wala tha. Lekin kisi cheez ne koi faida na diya, azaab-e-Ilahi se sab cheezein dunya mein hi tabah aur khaak-e-siyah ho gayin. Allah jis ki rozi kushada karna chahe, kushada kar deta hai aur jis ki rozi tang karna chahe, tang kar deta hai. Dunya mein to woh apne doston, dushmanon sab ko deta hai. Ghani ya faqeer hona us ki razamandi aur narazgi ki daleel nahin, balkay is mein aur hikmatein hoti hain jinhein aksar log jaan nahin sakte. Maal-o-aulad ko hamari inayat ki daleel banana ghalti hai. Yeh koi hamare paas martaba badhane wali cheez nahin. Rasool Allah (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) farmate hain Allah Ta'ala tumhari suraton aur maalon ko nahin dekhta balkay dilon aur amalon ko dekhta hai. (Sahih Muslim). Haan us ke paas darjaat dilane wali cheez imaan aur nek aamaal hain. Un ki nekiyon ke badle unhein bahut badha chadha kar diye jayenge. Ek ek neki das das guna balkay saat saat sau guna kar ke di jayegi. Jannat ki buland tareen manzilon mein har darr, khauf se, gham se pur-amn honge. Koi dukh dard na hoga.

Phir farmata hai ke Allah Ta'ala apni hikmat-e-kamilah ke mutabiq jise chahe bahut sari duniya deta hai aur jise chahe bahut kam deta hai, koi sukh-chain mein hai koi dukh-dard mein mubtala hai. Rabb ki hikmaton ko koi nahin jaan sakta, us ki maslahatein wahi khoob jaanta hai. Duniya mein sab se behtar shakhs Rasool (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ke farman ke mutabiq woh hai jo sacha musalman ho aur ba-qadr-e-kifayat rozi pata ho aur Allah ki taraf se qana'at bhi diya gaya ho. Hazrat Bilal (R.A) se ek martaba Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne farmaya Bilal kharch kar aur Arsh wale ki taraf se tangi ka khayal bhi na kar. Ibn Abi Hatim mein hai Rasoolullah (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) farmate hain tumhare is zamane ke baad aisa zamana aa raha hai jo kaat khane wala hoga. Maal hoga lekin maldar ne goya apne maal par daant garay hue honge ke kahin kharch na ho jaye. Phir Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne isi aayat mein (WAMA ANFAQ-TUM MIN NAFQATIN AW NAZARTUM MIN NAZRIN FA-INNALLAHA YA'LAMUHU WAMA LIZZALIMINA MIN ANSAR 270) (Al-Baqarah: 270) ki tilawat farmayi aur hadith mein hai badtareen log woh hain jo bebas aur muztar logon ki cheezein kam daamon khareedte phirein. Yaad rakho aisi bai' haram hai, muztar ki bai' haram hai. Musalman musalman ka bhai hai na us par zulm kare na use ruswa kare. Agar tujh se ho sake to dusre ke sath achha sulook aur bhalai kar warna us ki halakat ko to na barha. (Abu Ya'la Mosali). Yeh hadith is sanad se ghareeb hai aur za'eef bhi hai. Hazrat Mujahid farmate hain kahin is aayat ka ghalat matlab na le lena. Apne maal ko kharch karne mein miyana-rawi karna.

Ibn-e-Abi Hatim mein hai Abu Razin farmate hain ke do shakhs aapas mein shareek thay ek to samundar paar chala gaya, ek wahin raha jab Aan-Hazrat (ﷺ) mab'oos hue to us ne apne saathi se likh kar daryaft kiya ke Huzoor (ﷺ) ka kya haal hai? Us ne jawab mein likha ke gire pade logon ne us ki baat maani hai. Shareef Quraishiyon ne us ki ita'at nahin ki. Is khat ko parh kar woh apni tijarat chor chaar kar safar kar ke apne shareek ke paas pahuncha. Yeh parha likha aadmi tha, kitabon ka ilm use hasil tha. Us se poocha ke batao Huzoor (ﷺ) kahan hain? Maloom kar ke aap ki khidmat mein hazir hua aap se poocha ke aap logon ko kis cheez ki taraf bulate hain? Aap ne Islam ke arkaan us ke samne bayan farmaye. Woh use sunte hi iman le aaya. Aap ne farmaya tumhein is ki tasdeeq kyunkar ho gayi? Us ne kaha is baat se ke tamam ambiya ke ibtidai manne wale hamesha za'if maskeen log hi hote hain.

Is par yeh aayatein utrin aur Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne aadmi bhej kar un se kehwaya ke tumhari baat ki sachai Allah Ta'ala ne nazil farmayi. Isi tarah Heraclius ne kaha tha jab ke us ne Abu Sufyan se un ki jahiliyat ki halat mein Aan-Hazrat (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ki nisbat daryaft kiya tha ke kya shareef logon ne un ki tabedari ki hai ya zaeefon ne? To Abu Sufyan ne jawab diya ke zaeefon ne. Is par Heraclius ne kaha tha ke har Rasool ki awwalan tabedari karne wale yahi zaeef log hote hain, phir farmaya yeh khush-haal log maal-o-aulad ki kasrat par hi fakhr karte hain aur ise is baat ki daleel banate hain ke woh pasandida hain Allah ke. Agar Allah ki khaas inayat-o-meharbani un par na hoti to unhein yeh ne'matein na deta aur jab yahan Rabb-e-Meharban hai to aakhirat mein bhi woh meharban hi rahega. Quran ne har jagah is ka radd kiya hai, ek jagah farmaya (A-yahsabuna annama numidduhum bihi min-maliw-wa-banin) (Surah (Al-Mu'minun: 55) kya un ka khayal hai ke maal-o-aulad ki aksariyat un ke liye behtar hai? Nahin balkay burai hai lekin yeh beshoor hain. Ek aur aayat mein hai (Wala tu'jibka amwaluhum wa-auladuhum innama yuridullahu ay-yu'azzibahum biha fid-dunya wa-tazhaqa anfusuhum wahum kafirun) (Surah (At-Tawbah: 85) un ki maal-o-aulad tujhe dhoke mein na daale, is se unhein dunya mein bhi saza hogi aur marte dam tak yeh kufr par hi rahenge. Aur aayaton mein hai (Zarni waman khalaqtu wahida) (Surah (Al-Muddaththir: 11) yani mujhe aur us shakhs ko chhod de jise bahut se farzand de rakhe hain aur har tarah ka aish us ke liye muhayya kar diya hai. Taham use tama' hai ke main aur zyada doon. Aisa nahin, yeh hamari aayaton ka mukhalif hai. Zamana jaanta hai ke ise main dozakh ke pahadon par chadhaunga. Is shakhs ka waqia bhi mazkoor hua hai jis ke do baagh thay, maal wala, phalon wala, aulad wala tha. Lekin kisi cheez ne koi faida na diya, azaab-e-Ilahi se sab cheezein dunya mein hi tabah aur khaak-e-siyah ho gayin. Allah jis ki rozi kushada karna chahe, kushada kar deta hai aur jis ki rozi tang karna chahe, tang kar deta hai. Dunya mein to woh apne doston, dushmanon sab ko deta hai. Ghani ya faqeer hona us ki razamandi aur narazgi ki daleel nahin, balkay is mein aur hikmatein hoti hain jinhein aksar log jaan nahin sakte. Maal-o-aulad ko hamari inayat ki daleel banana ghalti hai. Yeh koi hamare paas martaba badhane wali cheez nahin. Rasool Allah (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) farmate hain Allah Ta'ala tumhari suraton aur maalon ko nahin dekhta balkay dilon aur amalon ko dekhta hai. (Sahih Muslim). Haan us ke paas darjaat dilane wali cheez imaan aur nek aamaal hain. Un ki nekiyon ke badle unhein bahut badha chadha kar diye jayenge. Ek ek neki das das guna balkay saat saat sau guna kar ke di jayegi. Jannat ki buland tareen manzilon mein har darr, khauf se, gham se pur-amn honge. Koi dukh dard na hoga.

Iza aur sadma na hoga. Rasoolullah (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) farmate hain jannat mein aise bala-khane hain jin ka zahir batin se aur batin zahir se nazar aata hai. Ek a'rabi ne kaha yeh bala-khane kis ke liye hain? Aap (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne farmaya jo narm-kalami kare, khana khilaye, bakasrat rozay rakhe aur logon ki neend ke waqt tahajjud parhe. (Ibn Abi Hatim). Jo log Allah ki rah se auron ko rokte hain, rasoolon ki tabedari se logon ko baz rakhte hain, Allah ki aayaton ki tasdeeq nahin karte, woh jahannam ki saza mein hazir kiye jayenge aur bura badla payenge. Phir farmata hai ke Allah Ta'ala apni hikmat-e-kamilah ke mutabiq jise chahe bahut sari duniya deta hai aur jise chahe bahut kam deta hai, koi sukh-chain mein hai koi dukh-dard mein mubtala hai. Rabb ki hikmaton ko koi nahin jaan sakta, us ki maslahatein wahi khoob jaanta hai.
