Ya'ni jis tarah faqr-o-ghina ke sath darjon ki oonch-neech yahan hai, isi tarah aakhirat mein bhi a'maal ke mutabiq darajat-o-darkaat honge. Nek log to jannaton ke buland-o-bala khanon mein aur bad log jahannam ke neeche ke tabqe ke jail khanon mein. Duniya mein sab se behtar shakhs Rasool (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ke farman ke mutabiq woh hai jo sacha musalman ho aur ba-qadr-e-kifayat rozi pata ho aur Allah ki taraf se qana'at bhi diya gaya ho. (Muslim). Allah ke hukm ya us ki ibahat ke matahat tum jo kuch kharch karoge us ka badla woh tumhein dono jahan mein dega. Sahih hadith mein hai ke har subh ek farishta dua karta hai ke Allah bakheel ke maal ko talaf aur barbad kar, dusra dua karta hai Allah kharch karne wale ko nek badla de. Hazrat Bilal (R.A) se ek martaba Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne farmaya Bilal kharch kar aur Arsh wale ki taraf se tangi ka khayal bhi na kar. Ibn Abi Hatim mein hai Rasoolullah (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) farmate hain tumhare is zamane ke baad aisa zamana aa raha hai jo kaat khane wala hoga. Maal hoga lekin maldar ne goya apne maal par daant garay hue honge ke kahin kharch na ho jaye. Phir Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne isi aayat mein (WAMA ANFAQ-TUM MIN NAFQATIN AW NAZARTUM MIN NAZRIN FA-INNALLAHA YA'LAMUHU WAMA LIZZALIMINA MIN ANSAR 270) (Al-Baqarah: 270) ki tilawat farmayi aur hadith mein hai badtareen log woh hain jo bebas aur muztar logon ki cheezein kam daamon khareedte phirein. Yaad rakho aisi bai' haram hai, muztar ki bai' haram hai. Musalman musalman ka bhai hai na us par zulm kare na use ruswa kare. Agar tujh se ho sake to dusre ke sath achha sulook aur bhalai kar warna us ki halakat ko to na barha. (Abu Ya'la Mosali). Yeh hadith is sanad se ghareeb hai aur za'eef bhi hai. Hazrat Mujahid farmate hain kahin is aayat ka ghalat matlab na le lena. Apne maal ko kharch karne mein miyana-rawi karna.

Agar Allah ki khaas inayat-o-meharbani un par na hoti to unhein yeh ne'matein na deta aur jab yahan Rabb-e-Meharban hai to aakhirat mein bhi woh meharban hi rahega. Quran ne har jagah is ka radd kiya hai, ek jagah farmaya (A-yahsabuna annama numidduhum bihi min-maliw-wa-banin) (Surah (Al-Mu'minun: 55) kya un ka khayal hai ke maal-o-aulad ki aksariyat un ke liye behtar hai? Nahin balkay burai hai lekin yeh beshoor hain. Ek aur aayat mein hai (Wala tu'jibka amwaluhum wa-auladuhum innama yuridullahu ay-yu'azzibahum biha fid-dunya wa-tazhaqa anfusuhum wahum kafirun) (Surah (At-Tawbah: 85) un ki maal-o-aulad tujhe dhoke mein na daale, is se unhein dunya mein bhi saza hogi aur marte dam tak yeh kufr par hi rahenge. Aur aayaton mein hai (Zarni waman khalaqtu wahida) (Surah (Al-Muddaththir: 11) yani mujhe aur us shakhs ko chhod de jise bahut se farzand de rakhe hain aur har tarah ka aish us ke liye muhayya kar diya hai. Taham use tama' hai ke main aur zyada doon. Aisa nahin, yeh hamari aayaton ka mukhalif hai. Zamana jaanta hai ke ise main dozakh ke pahadon par chadhaunga. Is shakhs ka waqia bhi mazkoor hua hai jis ke do baagh thay, maal wala, phalon wala, aulad wala tha. Lekin kisi cheez ne koi faida na diya, azaab-e-Ilahi se sab cheezein dunya mein hi tabah aur khaak-e-siyah ho gayin. Allah jis ki rozi kushada karna chahe, kushada kar deta hai aur jis ki rozi tang karna chahe, tang kar deta hai. Dunya mein to woh apne doston, dushmanon sab ko deta hai. Ghani ya faqeer hona us ki razamandi aur narazgi ki daleel nahin, balkay is mein aur hikmatein hoti hain jinhein aksar log jaan nahin sakte. Maal-o-aulad ko hamari inayat ki daleel banana ghalti hai. Yeh koi hamare paas martaba badhane wali cheez nahin. Rasool Allah (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) farmate hain Allah Ta'ala tumhari suraton aur maalon ko nahin dekhta balkay dilon aur amalon ko dekhta hai. (Sahih Muslim). Haan us ke paas darjaat dilane wali cheez imaan aur nek aamaal hain. Un ki nekiyon ke badle unhein bahut badha chadha kar diye jayenge. Ek ek neki das das guna balkay saat saat sau guna kar ke di jayegi. Jannat ki buland tareen manzilon mein har darr, khauf se, gham se pur-amn honge. Koi dukh dard na hoga.

Iza aur sadma na hoga. Rasoolullah (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) farmate hain jannat mein aise bala-khane hain jin ka zahir batin se aur batin zahir se nazar aata hai. Ek a'rabi ne kaha yeh bala-khane kis ke liye hain? Aap (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne farmaya jo narm-kalami kare, khana khilaye, bakasrat rozay rakhe aur logon ki neend ke waqt tahajjud parhe. (Ibn Abi Hatim). Jo log Allah ki rah se auron ko rokte hain, rasoolon ki tabedari se logon ko baz rakhte hain, Allah ki aayaton ki tasdeeq nahin karte, woh jahannam ki saza mein hazir kiye jayenge aur bura badla payenge. Phir farmata hai ke Allah Ta'ala apni hikmat-e-kamilah ke mutabiq jise chahe bahut sari duniya deta hai aur jise chahe bahut kam deta hai, koi sukh-chain mein hai koi dukh-dard mein mubtala hai. Rabb ki hikmaton ko koi nahin jaan sakta, us ki maslahatein wahi khoob jaanta hai. Jaise farmaya (UNZUR KAYFA FAZZALNA BA'ZAHUM 'ALA BA'ZIN WA LAL-AKHIRATU AKBARU DARAJATIN WA AKBARU TAFZILA 21) (Al-Isra: 21) to dekh le ke hum ne kis tarah ek ko dusre par fazeelat de rakhi hai aur albatta aakhirat darjon aur fazeelaton mein bahut bari hai. Ya'ni jis tarah faqr-o-ghina ke sath darjon ki oonch-neech yahan hai, isi tarah aakhirat mein bhi a'maal ke mutabiq darajat-o-darkaat honge. Nek log to jannaton ke buland-o-bala khanon mein aur bad log jahannam ke neeche ke tabqe ke jail khanon mein. Duniya mein sab se behtar shakhs Rasool (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ke farman ke mutabiq woh hai jo sacha musalman ho aur ba-qadr-e-kifayat rozi pata ho aur Allah ki taraf se qana'at bhi diya gaya ho. (Muslim). Allah ke hukm ya us ki ibahat ke matahat tum jo kuch kharch karoge us ka badla woh tumhein dono jahan mein dega. Sahih hadith mein hai ke har subh ek farishta dua karta hai ke Allah bakheel ke maal ko talaf aur barbad kar, dusra dua karta hai Allah kharch karne wale ko nek badla de. Hazrat Bilal (R.A) se ek martaba Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne farmaya Bilal kharch kar aur Arsh wale ki taraf se tangi ka khayal bhi na kar. Ibn Abi Hatim mein hai Rasoolullah (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) farmate hain tumhare is zamane ke baad aisa zamana aa raha hai jo kaat khane wala hoga. Maal hoga lekin maldar ne goya apne maal par daant garay hue honge ke kahin kharch na ho jaye. Phir Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne isi aayat mein (WAMA ANFAQ-TUM MIN NAFQATIN AW NAZARTUM MIN NAZRIN FA-INNALLAHA YA'LAMUHU WAMA LIZZALIMINA MIN ANSAR 270) (Al-Baqarah: 270) ki tilawat farmayi aur hadith mein hai badtareen log woh hain jo bebas aur muztar logon ki cheezein kam daamon khareedte phirein. Yaad rakho aisi bai' haram hai, muztar ki bai' haram hai. Musalman musalman ka bhai hai na us par zulm kare na use ruswa kare. Agar tujh se ho sake to dusre ke sath achha sulook aur bhalai kar warna us ki halakat ko to na barha. (Abu Ya'la Mosali). Yeh hadith is sanad se ghareeb hai aur za'eef bhi hai. Hazrat Mujahid farmate hain kahin is aayat ka ghalat matlab na le lena. Apne maal ko kharch karne mein miyana-rawi karna.

Nabi-e-Akram (ﷺ) ke liye tasalliyan. Allah Ta'ala apne Nabi (ﷺ) ko tasalli deta hai aur agle paighambaron ki si seerat rakhne ko farmata hai. Farmata hai ke jis basti mein jo Rasool gaya us ka muqabla hua. Bade logon ne kufr kiya, haan ghurbaa ne tabedari ki jaise ke Qaum-e-Nuh ne apne Nabi se kaha tha (QALU ANUMINU LAKA WATTABA'AKAL ARZALUN) (Surah (Ash-Shu'ara: 111). Hum tujh par kaise iman layein tere manne wale to sab neeche darje ke log hain. Yehi mazmoon dusri ayat (WAMA NARAKA ITTABA'AKA ILLA LLAZINA HUM ARAZILUNA BADIYAR RA'YI) (Surah (Hud: 27), mein hai. Qaum-e-Saleh ke mutakabbir log za'ifon se kehte hain (ATA'LAMUNA ANNA SALIHAN MURSALUM MIR RABBIHI QALU INNA BIMA URSILA BIHI MU'MINUN) (Surah (Al-A'raf: 75). Kya tumhein Hazrat Saleh (A.S) ke Nabi hone ka yaqeen hai? Unhon ne kaha haan hum to momin hain. To mutakabbireen ne saaf kaha ke hum nahin maante. Aur ayat mein hai (WAKAZALIKA FATANNA BA'DAHUM BIBA'DIN LIYAQULU AHA'ULA'I MANNALLAHU ALAIHIM MIM BAININA ALAISALLAHU BI A'LAMA BISH-SHAKIRIN) (Surah (Al-An'am: 53), yani isi tarah hum ne ek ko dusre se fitne mein dala taake woh kahein kya yehi log hain jin par Allah ne hum sab mein se ehsan kiya. Kya Allah shukarguzaron ko janne wala nahin? Aur farmaya har basti mein wahan ke bade log mujrim aur makkar hote hain aur farman hai (WAIZA ARADNA AN NUHLIKA QARYATAN AMARNA MUTRAFIHA FAFASAQU FIHA FAHAQQA ALAIHAL QAWLU FADAMMARNAHA TADMIRA) (Surah (Al-Isra: 16). Jab kisi basti ki halakat ka hum irada karte hain to us ke sarkash logon ko kuch ahkaam dete hain woh nahin maante phir hum unhein halak kar dete hain. Pas yahan bhi farmata hai ke hum ne jis basti mein koi Nabi aur Rasool bheja wahan ke jaah-o-hashmat, shaan-o-shaukat wale ra'ison, amiron, sardaron aur bade logon ne jhat apne kufr ka elaan kar diya. Ibn-e-Abi Hatim mein hai Abu Razin farmate hain ke do shakhs aapas mein shareek thay ek to samundar paar chala gaya, ek wahin raha jab Aan-Hazrat (ﷺ) mab'oos hue to us ne apne saathi se likh kar daryaft kiya ke Huzoor (ﷺ) ka kya haal hai? Us ne jawab mein likha ke gire pade logon ne us ki baat maani hai. Shareef Quraishiyon ne us ki ita'at nahin ki. Maloom kar ke aap ki khidmat mein hazir hua aap se poocha ke aap logon ko kis cheez ki taraf bulate hain? Aap ne Islam ke arkaan us ke samne bayan farmaye. Woh use sunte hi iman le aaya. Aap ne farmaya tumhein is ki tasdeeq kyunkar ho gayi? Us ne kaha is baat se ke tamam ambiya ke ibtidai manne wale hamesha za'if maskeen log hi hote hain.

Mushrikeen se sawal. Mushrikeen ko sharminda, lajawab aur be-uzr karne ke liye un ke samne farishton se sawal hoga. Jin ki masnooi shaklein bana kar yeh mushrik duniya mein poojte rahe ke woh unhein Allah se mila dein. Sawal hoga ke kya tum ne unhein apni ibadat karne ko kaha tha? Jaise Surah Furqan mein hai (ءَ اَنْتُمْ اَضْلَلْتُمْ عِبَادِيْ هٰٓؤُلَاۗءِ اَمْ هُمْ ضَلُّوا السَّبِيْلَ 17؀ۭ) (25-Al-Furqan: 17) yani kya tum ne unhein gumrah kiya tha? Yeh khud hi behke hue thay? Hazrat Isa (A.S) se yahi sawal hoga ke kya tum logon se keh aaye thay ke Allah ko chhod kar meri aur meri maa ki ibadat karna? Aap jawab denge ke Allah teri zaat paak hai, jo kehna mujhe sazawaar na tha, use main kaise keh deta? Isi tarah farishtey bhi apni baraat zahir karenge aur kahenge tu is se bahut buland aur paak hai tera koi shareek ho. Hum to khud tere bandey thay, hum in se bezar rahe aur ab bhi in se alag hain. Yeh shayateen ki parastish karte thay. Shaitanon ne hi in ke liye buton ki pooja ko muzayyan kar rakha tha aur unhein gumrah kar diya tha, in mein se aksar ka shaitan par hi etiqad tha. Jaise farman-e-Bari hai (اِنْ يَّدْعُوْنَ مِنْ دُوْنِهٖٓ اِلَّآ اِنَاثًا ۚ وَاِنْ يَّدْعُوْنَ اِلَّا شَيْطٰنًا مَّرِيْدًا 117؀ۭ) (4-An-Nisa: 117) yani yeh log Allah ko chhod kar auraton ki parastish karte hain aur sarkash shaitan ki ibadat karte hain. Jis par Allah ki phitkar hai, pas jin jin se tum mushriko! lau (umeed) lagaye hue thay, un mein se ek bhi aaj tumhein koi nafa na pahuncha sake ga. Is shiddat-o-karb ke waqt yeh saare jhoote mabood tum se yak-soo ho jayenge kyunke unhein kisi ke kisi tarah ke nafa-o-zarar ka ikhtiyar tha hi nahin. Aaj hum khud mushrikon se farma denge ke lau jis azab-e-jahannam ko jhutla rahe thay aaj is ka maza chakho.

Isi tarah farishtey bhi apni baraat zahir karenge aur kahenge tu is se bahut buland aur paak hai tera koi shareek ho. Hum to khud tere bandey thay, hum in se bezar rahe aur ab bhi in se alag hain. Yeh shayateen ki parastish karte thay. Shaitanon ne hi in ke liye buton ki pooja ko muzayyan kar rakha tha aur unhein gumrah kar diya tha, in mein se aksar ka shaitan par hi etiqad tha. Jaise farman-e-Bari hai (اِنْ يَّدْعُوْنَ مِنْ دُوْنِهٖٓ اِلَّآ اِنَاثًا ۚ وَاِنْ يَّدْعُوْنَ اِلَّا شَيْطٰنًا مَّرِيْدًا 117؀ۭ) (4-An-Nisa: 117) yani yeh log Allah ko chhod kar auraton ki parastish karte hain aur sarkash shaitan ki ibadat karte hain. Jis par Allah ki phitkar hai, pas jin jin se tum mushriko! lau (umeed) lagaye hue thay, un mein se ek bhi aaj tumhein koi nafa na pahuncha sake ga. Is shiddat-o-karb ke waqt yeh saare jhoote mabood tum se yak-soo ho jayenge kyunke unhein kisi ke kisi tarah ke nafa-o-zarar ka ikhtiyar tha hi nahin. Aaj hum khud mushrikon se farma denge ke lau jis azab-e-jahannam ko jhutla rahe thay aaj is ka maza chakho.

Kafir azab-e-Ilahi ke mustahiq kyun thehre? Kafiron ki woh shararat bayan ho rahi hai jis ke baais woh Allah ke azabon ke mustahiq hue hain ke Allah ka kalam taza-ba-taza us ke afzal Rasool (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ki zaban se sunte hain, qabool karna, manna us ke mutabiq amal karna toh ek taraf, kehte hain ke dekho yeh shakhs tumhein tumhare purane achhe aur sache deen se rok raha hai aur apne batil khayalat ki taraf tumhein bula raha hai yeh Quran toh is ka khud tarashida hai aap hi ghar leta hai aur yeh toh jadu hai aur is ka jadu hona kuch dhaka chupa nahin, bilkul zahir hai. Phir farmata hai ke in Arabon ki taraf na toh is se pehle koi kitab bheji gayi hai na aap se pehle in mein koi Rasool aaya hai. Is liye inhein muddaton se tamanna thi ke agar Allah ka Rasool hum mein aata agar Kitabullah hum mein utarti toh hum sab se zyada muti aur paband ho jate. Lekin jab Allah ne in ki yeh derina arzoo poori ki toh jhutlane aur inkar karne lage, in se agli ummaton ke natije in ke samne hain. Woh quwwat-o-taqat, maal-o-mata, asbab-e-duniyawi in logon se bahut zyada rakhte the. Yeh toh abhi in ke daswein hisse ko bhi nahin pohunche lekin mere azab ke baad na maal kaam aaye, na aulad aur kunbe qabile kaam aaye. Na quwwat-o-taqat ne koi fayda diya. Barbad kar diye gaye jaise farmaya (وَلَقَدْ مَكَّنّٰهُمْ فِيْمَآ اِنْ مَّكَّنّٰكُمْ فِيْهِ وَجَعَلْنَا لَهُمْ سَمْعًا وَّاَبْصَارًا وَّاَفْـــِٕدَةً 26؀) (Surah (Al-Ahqaf: 26) yani hum ne inhein quwwat-o-taqat de rakhi thi. Aankhein aur kaan bhi rakhte the, dil bhi the lekin meri aayaton ke inkar par jab azab aaya us waqt kisi cheez ne kuch fayda na diya aur jis ke sath mazaq udate the us ne inhein gher liya. Kya yeh log zameen mein chal phir kar apne se pehle logon ka anjam nahin dekhte jo in se tadaad mein zyada taqat mein badhe hue the. Matlab yeh hai ke Rasoolon ke jhutlane ke baais pees diye gaye, jad se ukhaad kar phenk diye gaye. Tum gaur kar lo! Dekh lo ke main ne kis tarah apne Rasoolon ki nusrat ki aur kis tarah jhutlane walon par apna azab utara?)

Zidd aur hat-dharmi kuffar ka shewa. Hukm hota hai ke yeh kafir jo tujhe majnoon bata rahe hain, un se keh ke ek kaam toh karo khuloos ke sath ta'assub aur zidd ko chhod kar zara si der socho toh aapas mein ek dusre se daryaft karo ke kya Muhammad (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) majnoon hain? Aur imandari se ek dusre ko jawab do. Har shakhs tanha tanha bhi gaur kare aur dusron se bhi puche lekin yeh shart hai ke zidd aur hat ko dimagh se nikal kar ta'assub aur hat-dharmi chhod kar gaur kare. Tumhein khud maloom ho jayega, tumhare dil se aawaz uthegi ke haqeeqat mein Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ko junoon nahin. Balkeh woh tum sab ke khair-khwah hain dard-mand hain. Ek aane wale khatre se jis se tum be-khabar ho woh tumhein aagah kar rahe hain. Ba'az logon ne is aayat se tanha aur jama'at se namaz padhne ka matlab samjha hai aur is ke suboot mein ek hadith bhi pesh karte hain lekin woh hadith za'eef hai. Is mein hai ke Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne farmaya mujhe teen cheezein di gayi hain jo mujh se pehle kisi ko nahin di gayi yeh main fakhr ke taur par nahin keh raha hoon. Mere liye maal-e-ghaneemat halal kiya gaya mujh se pehle kisi ke liye woh halal nahin hua woh maal-e-ghaneemat ko jama kar ke jala dete the aur main har surkh-o-siyah ki taraf bheja gaya hoon aur har nabi sirf apni hi qoum ki taraf bheja jata raha. Mere liye saari zameen masjid aur wuzu ki cheez bana di gayi hai. Taake main is ki mitti se tayammum kar loon aur jahan bhi hoon aur namaz ka waqt aa jaye namaz ada kar loon. Allah Ta'ala farmata hai Allah ke samne ba-adab khade ho jaya karo do-do aur ek-ek aur ek mahina ki raah tak meri madad sirf ra'ab se ki gayi hai. Yeh hadith sanadan za'eef hai aur bahut mumkin hai ke is mein aayat ka zikr aur use jama'at se ya alag namaz padh lene ke ma'ani mein le lena yeh rawi ka apna qaul ho aur is tarah bayan kar diya gaya ho ke ba-zahir woh alfaaz hadith ke maloom hote hain kyunke Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ki khusoosiyat ki hadithein ba-sanad-e-sahih bahut se marwi hain aur kisi mein bhi yeh alfaaz nahin, Wallahu A'alam. Aap logon ko is azaab se darane wale hain jo un ke aage hai aur jis se yeh bilkul be-khabar be-fikri se baithe hue hain. Sahih Bukhari Sharif mein hai ke Nabi (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ek din Safa pahadi par chadh gaye aur Arab ke dastoor ke mutabiq Ya Sabaha keh kar buland aawaz ki jo alamat thi ke koi shakhs kisi ahem baat ke liye bula raha hai. Aadat ke mutabiq use sunte hi log jama ho gaye. Aap ne farmaya agar main tumhein khabar doon ke dushman tumhari taraf chadhai kar ke chala aa raha hai aur ajab nahin ke subh-o-sham hi tum par hamla kar de toh kya tum mujhe saccha samjhoge? Sab ne yak-zaban jawab diya ke haan beshak hum aap ko saccha janenge. Aap ne farmaya suno main tumhein is azaab se dara raha hoon jo tumhare aage hai. Yeh sun kar Abu Lahab mal'oon ne kaha tere haath tootein kya isi ke liye toh ne hum sab ko jama kiya tha? Is par Surah Tabbat utri. Yeh hadithein (Wa Anzir 'Asheeratakal Aqrabeen) (Surah (Ash-Shu'ara: 214) ki tafsir mein guzar chuki hain.

Musnad-e-Ahmad mein hai ke Rasool Allah (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) nikle aur hamare paas aa kar teen martaba aawaz di. Farmaya logo! Meri aur apni misaal jaante ho? Unhon ne kaha Allah ko aur uske Rasool (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ko poora ilm hai. Aap (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne farmaya meri aur tumhari misaal us qoum jaisi hai jin par dushman hamla karne wala tha. Unhon ne apna aadmi bheja ke ja kar dekhe aur dushman ki naql-o-harkat se unhein muttala kare. Us ne jab dekha ke dushman un ki taraf chala aa raha hai aur qareeb pahunch chuka hai to woh lapakta hua qoum ki taraf badha ke kahin aisa na ho ke mere ittila pahunchane se pehle hi dushman hamla na kar de. Is liye us ne raaste mein se hi apna kapda hilana shuru kiya ke hoshiyar ho jao dushman aa pahuncha, hoshiyar ho jao dushman aa pahuncha, teen martaba yahi kaha. Ek aur hadith mein hai main aur Qayamat ek saath hi bheje gaye, qareeb tha ke Qayamat mujh se pehle hi aa jaati.)

Mushrikeen ko dawat-e-islah. Hukm ho raha hai ke mushrikon se farma dijiye ke main jo tumhari khair-khwahi karta hoon, tumhein ahkam-e-deeni pahunchata raha hoon, wa'z-o-nasihat karta hoon, is par main tum se kisi badle ka talib nahin hoon. Badla toh Allah hi dega jo tamam cheezon ki haqeeqat se muttali hai, meri tumhari halat us par khoob roshan hai. Phir jo farmaya isi tarah ki aayat (RAFI'UD-DARAJATI ZUL-'ARSHI YULQIR-RUHA MIN AMRIHI 'ALA MAY-YASHA'U MIN 'IBADIHI LIYUNZIRA YAWMAT-TALAQ) (Ghafir: 15) hai, yani Allah Ta'ala apne farman se Hazrat Jibraeel (A.S) ko jis par chahta hai apni wahi ke sath bhejta hai. Jo haq ke sath farishta utarta hai. Woh 'Allam-ul-Ghuyub hai, us par aasman-o-zameen ki koi cheez makhfi nahin, Allah ki taraf se haq aur mubarak shariat aa chuki. Batil paraganda, boda ho kar barbad ho gaya. Jaise farman hai (BAL NAQZIFU BIL-HAQQI 'ALAL-BATILI FAYADMAGUHU FA-IZA HUWA ZAHIQUN WA LAKUMUL-WAYLU MIMMA TASIFUN) (Al-Anbiya: 18) hum batil par haq ko nazil farma kar batil ke tukde uda dete hain aur woh chakna choor ho jata hai. Aan-Hazrat (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) Fatah-e-Makkah wale din jab Baitullah mein dakhil hue toh wahan ke buton ko apni kamaan ki lakdi se girate jate the aur zaban se farmate jate the (WA QUL JA'AL-HAQQU WA ZAHAQAL-BATILU INNAL-BATILA KANA ZAHOOQA) (Al-Isra: 81) haq aa gaya, batil mit gaya, woh tha hi mitne wala. (Bukhari, Muslim). Batil ka aur nahaq ka dabao sab khatam ho gaya. Ba'az mufassireen se marwi hai ke murad yahan batil se Iblees hai. Yani na usne kisi ko pehle paida kiya na aayinda kar sake, na murde ko zinda kar sake, na use koi aur aisi qudrat hasil hai. Baat toh yeh bhi sachi hai lekin yahan yeh murad nahin. Wallahu A'lam. Phir jo farmaya us ka matlab yeh hai ke khair sab ki sab Allah Ta'ala ki taraf se hai aur Allah ki bheji hui wahi mein hai. Wohi sarasar haq hai aur hidayat-o-bayan-o-rushd hai. Gumrah hone wale aap hi bigad rahe hain aur apna hi nuqsan kar rahe hain. Hazrat Abdullah bin Mas'ood (R.A) se jab ke mufawwaza ka mas'ala daryaft kiya gaya tha toh aap ne farmaya tha ise main apni raye se bayan karta hoon agar sahi ho toh Allah ki taraf se hai aur agar ghalat ho toh meri aur Shaitan ki taraf se hai aur Allah aur us ka Rasool (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) is se bari hai. Woh Allah apne bandon ki baton ka sunne wala hai aur qareeb hai. Pukarne wale ki har pukar ko har waqt sunta aur qabool farmata hai. Bukhari-o-Muslim ki hadith mein hai Rasool Allah (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne ek martaba apne as-hab se farmaya tum kisi behre ya ghaib ko nahin pukare rahe. Jise tum pukare rahe ho woh Sami'o-Qareeb-o-Mujeeb hai.

Hazrat Abdullah bin Mas'ood (R.A) se jab ke mufawwaza ka mas'ala daryaft kiya gaya tha toh aap ne farmaya tha ise main apni raye se bayan karta hoon agar sahi ho toh Allah ki taraf se hai aur agar ghalat ho toh meri aur Shaitan ki taraf se hai aur Allah aur us ka Rasool (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) is se bari hai. Woh Allah apne bandon ki baton ka sunne wala hai aur qareeb hai. Pukarne wale ki har pukar ko har waqt sunta aur qabool farmata hai. Bukhari-o-Muslim ki hadith mein hai Rasool Allah (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne ek martaba apne as-hab se farmaya tum kisi behre ya ghaib ko nahin pukare rahe. Jise tum pukare rahe ho woh Sami'o-Qareeb-o-Mujeeb hai.

Mushrikeen ko dawat-e-islah. Hukm ho raha hai ke mushrikon se farma dijiye ke main jo tumhari khair-khwahi karta hoon, tumhein ahkam-e-deeni pahunchata raha hoon, wa'z-o-nasihat karta hoon, is par main tum se kisi badle ka talib nahin hoon. Badla toh Allah hi dega jo tamam cheezon ki haqeeqat se muttali hai, meri tumhari halat us par khoob roshan hai. Phir jo farmaya isi tarah ki aayat (RAFI'UD-DARAJATI ZUL-'ARSHI YULQIR-RUHA MIN AMRIHI 'ALA MAY-YASHA'U MIN 'IBADIHI LIYUNZIRA YAWMAT-TALAQ) (Ghafir: 15) hai, yani Allah Ta'ala apne farman se Hazrat Jibraeel (A.S) ko jis par chahta hai apni wahi ke sath bhejta hai. Jo haq ke sath farishta utarta hai. Woh 'Allam-ul-Ghuyub hai, us par aasman-o-zameen ki koi cheez makhfi nahin, Allah ki taraf se haq aur mubarak shariat aa chuki. Batil paraganda, boda ho kar barbad ho gaya. Jaise farman hai (BAL NAQZIFU BIL-HAQQI 'ALAL-BATILI FAYADMAGUHU FA-IZA HUWA ZAHIQUN WA LAKUMUL-WAYLU MIMMA TASIFUN) (Al-Anbiya: 18) hum batil par haq ko nazil farma kar batil ke tukde uda dete hain aur woh chakna choor ho jata hai. Aan-Hazrat (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) Fatah-e-Makkah wale din jab Baitullah mein dakhil hue toh wahan ke buton ko apni kamaan ki lakdi se girate jate the aur zaban se farmate jate the (WA QUL JA'AL-HAQQU WA ZAHAQAL-BATILU INNAL-BATILA KANA ZAHOOQA) (Al-Isra: 81) haq aa gaya, batil mit gaya, woh tha hi mitne wala. (Bukhari, Muslim). Batil ka aur nahaq ka dabao sab khatam ho gaya. Ba'az mufassireen se marwi hai ke murad yahan batil se Iblees hai. Yani na usne kisi ko pehle paida kiya na aayinda kar sake, na murde ko zinda kar sake, na use koi aur aisi qudrat hasil hai. Baat toh yeh bhi sachi hai lekin yahan yeh murad nahin. Wallahu A'lam. Gumrah hone wale aap hi bigad rahe hain aur apna hi nuqsan kar rahe hain. Woh Allah apne bandon ki baton ka sunne wala hai aur qareeb hai. Pukarne wale ki har pukar ko har waqt sunta aur qabool farmata hai. Bukhari-o-Muslim ki hadith mein hai Rasool Allah (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne ek martaba apne as-hab se farmaya tum kisi behre ya ghaib ko nahin pukare rahe. Jise tum pukare rahe ho woh Sami'o-Qareeb-o-Mujeeb hai.

Azab-e-Qayamat aur Kafir. Allah Tabarak-o-Ta'ala farma raha hai, aye Nabi (ﷺ), kaash ke aap in kafiron ki Qayamat ke din ki ghabrahat dekhte. Ke harchand azab se chutkara chahenge. Lekin bachao ki koi surat nahin payenge. Na bhag kar, na chup kar, na kisi ki himayat se, na kisi ki panah se. Balkeh foran hi qareeb se pakad liye jayenge. Idhar qabron se nikle idhar phans liye gaye. Idhar khade hue idhar giraftar kar liye gaye. Yeh bhi matlab ho sakta hai ke qatl-o-aseer hue. Lekin sahih yahi hai ke murad Qayamat ke din ke azab hain. Baaz kehte hain Bani Abbas ki khilafat ke zamane mein Makkah Madine ke darmiyan in lashkaron ka zameen mein dhansaya jana murad hai. Ibn-e-Jarir ne ise bayan kar ke is ki daleel mein ek hadith warid ki hai jo bilkul hi mauzoo aur ghadi hui hai. Lekin ta'ajjub sa ta'ajjub hai ke Imam sahab ne is ka mauzoo hona bayan nahin kiya. Qayamat ke din kahenge ke hum iman qabool karte hain Allah par, us ke farishton par, us ki kitabon par, us ke rasoolon par iman laye. Jaise aur ayat mein hai (Wa lau tara izil-mujrimoona nakisu ru'usihim inda rabbihim, rabbana absarna wa sami'na farji'na na'mal salihan inna muqinoon) (Surah (As-Sajdah: 12), kaash ke tu dekhta jabke gunahgar log apne Rab ke samne sar-nigoon khade honge aur sharmindagi se keh rahe honge ke Allah hum ne dekh sun liya, hamein yaqeen aa gaya. Ab to hamein phir se duniya mein bhej de to hum dil se manenge. Lekin koi shakhs jis tarah bahut door ki cheez ko lene ke liye door se hi hath badhaye aur us ke hath nahin aa sakti. Isi tarah yahi haal in logon ka hai ke akhirat mein woh kaam karte hain jo duniya mein karna chahiye tha. To akhirat mein iman lana besood hai. Ab na duniya mein lautaye jayen na us waqt ki girya-o-zari, tauba-o-faryad, iman-o-islam kuch kaam aayega. Is se pehle duniya mein to munkir rahe. Na Allah ko mana na Rasool par iman laye na Qayamat ke qail hue, yunhi jaise koi bin dekhe andaze se hi nishane par teer-bazi kar raha ho isi tarah Allah ki baton ko apne guman se hi rad karte rahe. Nabi (ﷺ) ko kabhi kahin keh diya kabhi shair bata diya. Kabhi jadugar kaha aur kabhi majnoon. Sirf atkal-pachoo ke sath Qayamat ko jhutlate rahe aur be-daleel adaron ki ibadat karte rahe, jannat dozakh ka mazaq udate rahe, ab iman aur in mein hijab aa gaya. Tauba mein aur in mein parda pad gaya. Duniya in se chhoot gayi. Yeh duniya se alag ho gaye. Ibn-e-Abi Hatim mein yahan par ek ajeeb-o-ghareeb asar naqal kiya hai jise hum poora hi naqal karte hain. Hazrat Ibn-e-Abbas (R.A) se marwi hai ke Bani Israel mein ek fatih shakhs tha jis ke paas maal bahut tha. Jab woh mar gaya aur us ka ladka us ka waris hua to buri tarah nafarmaniyon mein maal lutane laga. Us ke chachaon ne use malamat ki aur samjhaya us ne gusse mein aa kar sab cheezein bech kar rupiya le kar ain Shijajah ke paas aa kar ek mahal tameer kara kar yahan rehne laga.

Ek roz zor ki aandhi uthi jis mein ek bahut khubsurat khushbu-dar aurat us ke paas aa giri. Us ne us se pucha tum kaun ho? Us ne kaha Bani Israel ki shakhs hun. Kaha yeh mahal aur maal aap ka hai? Us ne kaha haan. Pucha aap ki biwi bhi hai? Kaha nahin. Kaha phir tum apni zindagi ka lutf kya uthate ho? Ab us ne pucha ke kya tumhara khawand hai? Us ne kaha nahin. Kaha phir mujhe qabool karo. Us ne jawab diya main yahan se meel bhar door rehti hun, kal tum yahan se apne saath din bhar ka khana peena le kar chalo aur mere haan aao. Raaste mein kuch ajaibat dekho to ghabrana nahin. Us ne qabool kiya aur dusre din tosha le kar chala. Meel bhar door ja kar ek nihayat aali-shan mahal dekha. Dastak dene se ek khubsurat naujawan shakhs aaya. Pucha aap kaun hain? Jawab diya ke main Bani Israel hun. Kaha kaise aaye hain? Kaha is makan ki malka ne bulwaya hai. Pucha raaste mein kuch holnak cheezein bhi dekhein? Jawab diya haan, aur agar mujhe yeh kaha hua na hota ke ghabrana mat to main haul-o-dehshat se halak ho gaya hota. Main chala, ek chauray raaste par pahuncha to dekha ke ek kutiya munh phaare baithi hui hai. Main ghabra kar daura to dekha ke mujh se aage aage woh hai aur us ke pallay (bachay) us ke pet mein hain aur bhonk rahe hain. Us naujawan ne kaha tu ise nahin payega, yeh to aakhir zamane mein hone wali ek baat ki misaal tujhe dikhayi gayi hai ke ek naujawan burhay baron ki majlis mein baithe ga aur un se apne raaz ki posheeda baatein kare ga. Main aur aage barha to dekha ek sau bakriyan hain jin ke than doodh se pur hain, ek bacha hai jo doodh pee raha hai, jab doodh khatam ho jata hai aur woh jaan leta hai ke aur kuch baqi nahin raha to woh munh khol deta hai goya aur maang raha hai. Us naujawan darban ne kaha tu ise bhi nahin payega, yeh misaal tujhe batayi gayi hai un badshahon ki jo aakhir zamane mein aayenge, logon se sona chandi ghaseetenge yahan tak ke samajh lenge ke ab kisi ke paas kuch nahin bacha to bhi woh zulm-o-ziyadati kar ke munh phailaye rahenge. Us ne kaha main aur aage barha to main ne ek darakht nihayat tar-o-taza, khush-rang aur khush-waza dekha. Main ne us ki ek tehni torni chahi to dusre darakht se aawaz aayi ke ae banday-e-ilahi! Meri daali tor ja, phir to har ek darakht se yahi aawaz aane lagi. Darban ne kaha tu ise bhi nahin payega, is mein ishara hai ke aakhir zamane mein mardon ki qillat aur aurton ki kasrat ho jaye gi, yahan tak ke jab ek mard ki taraf se kisi aurat ko paigham jaye ga to das bees auratein use apni taraf bulane lagen gi. Us ne kaha main aur aage barha to main ne dekha ke ek darya ke kinare ek shakhs khara hua hai aur logon ko pani bhar bhar kar de raha hai, phir apni mashk mein dalta hai lekin us mein ek qatra bhi nahin theherta. Darban ne kaha tu ise bhi nahin payega. Is mein ishara hai ke aakhir zamane mein aise ulama aur waiz honge jo logon ko ilm sikhayenge, bhali baatein batayenge.

Lekin khud aamil nahin honge. Balkeh khud gunahon mein mubtala rahege phir jo main aage badha toh main ne dekha ke ek bakri ko baaz logon ne toh uske paon pakad rakhe hain, baaz ne dum thaam rakhi hai, baaz ne seeng pakad rakhe hain, baaz us par sawaar hain aur baaz uska doodh dho rahe hain. Usne kaha yeh misaal hai duniya ki jo uske pair thaame hue hain. Yeh toh woh hain jo duniya se gir gaye jinhein yeh na mili jisne seeng thaam rakhe hain yeh woh hai jo apna guzara kar leta hai lekin tangi turshi se dum pakadne wale woh hain jinse duniya bhaag chuki hai. Sawaar woh hain jo az-khud taarik-e-duniya mein ho gaye hain. Haan duniya se sahih faida uthane wale woh hain jinhein tum ne is bakri ka doodh nikalte hue dekha. Unhein khushi ho yeh mustahiq-e-mubarak baad hain. Usne kaha main aur aage chala toh dekha ke ek shakhs ek kunwein mein se paani khench raha hai aur ek hauz mein daal raha hai jis hauz mein se paani phir kunwein mein chala jaata hai. Usne kaha yeh woh shakhs hai jo nek amal karta hai lekin qabool nahin hote. Usne kaha phir main aage badha toh dekha ke ek shakhs ne daane zameen mein boye usi waqt kheti tayyar ho gayi aur bahut achhe nafees gehun nikal aaye. Kaha yeh woh shakhs hai jiski nekiyan Allah Ta'ala qabool farmata hai. Usne kaha main aur aage badha toh dekha ke ek shakhs chit leta pada hai. Mujhse kehne laga bhai mera haath pakad kar bitha do, wallah jab se paida hua hoon, bitha hi nahin. Mere haath pakadte hi woh khada ho kar tez dauda yahan tak ke meri nazron se posheeda ho gaya. Is darbaan ne kaha yeh teri umar thi jo ja chuki aur khatam ho gayi main Malakul Maut hoon aur jis aurat se tu milne aaya hai uski surat mein bhi main hi tha Allah ke hukum se tere paas aaya tha ke teri rooh is jagah qabz karoon phir tujhe jahannam raseed karoon. Uske baare mein yeh aayat (Wa heela bainahum wa baina ma yashtahoon kama fu'ila bi-ashya'ihim min qabli innahum kanu fi shakkin mureeb) (Surah (Saba: 54), nazil hui. Yeh asar ghareeb hai aur iski sehat mein bhi nazar hai. Aayat ka matlab zahir hai ke kafiron ki jab maut aati hai unki rooh hayat-e-duniya ki lazzaton mein atki rehti hai. Lekin maut mohlat nahin deti aur unki khwahish aur unke darmiyan woh hail ho jaata hai. Jaise is maghroor-o-maftoon shakhs ka haal hua ke gaya toh aurat dhoondhne ko aur mulaqat hui Malakul Maut se. Umeed poori hone se pehle rooh parwaz kar gayi. Phir farmata hai unse pehle ki ummaton ke saath bhi yahi kiya gaya woh bhi maut ke waqt zindagi aur imaan ki aarzoo karte rahe. Jo mehez besood thi. Jaise farman-e-aali shaan hai (Falamma ra'au ba'sana qalu amanna billahi wahdahu wa kafarna bima kunna bihi mushrikeen) (Surah (Al-Mu'min: 84).

(Ghafir: 84) Jab unhon ne hamara azab dekh liya toh kehne lage hum Allah Wahid par iman laye aur jis jis ko hum shareek-e-Allah banate thay un sab se hum inkar karte hain lekin us waqt un ke iman ne unhein koi faida na diya. Un se pehluon mein bhi yahi tariqa jari raha, kuffar nafa se mehroom hi hain. Yahan farmaya ke duniya mein toh zindagi bhar shak-o-shuba mein aur taraddud mein hi rahe. Isi wajah se azab ke dekhne ke baad ka iman bekar raha. Hazrat Qatadah (R.H) ka yeh qaul aab-e-zar se likhne ke laiq hai, aap farmate hain ke shubhat aur shukook se bacho. Is par jis ki maut aayi woh Qayamat ke din bhi isi par uthaya jayega aur jo yaqeen par mara hai use yaqeen par hi uthaya jayega.)))

Azab-e-Qayamat aur Kafir. Allah Tabarak-o-Ta'ala farma raha hai, aye Nabi (ﷺ), kaash ke aap in kafiron ki Qayamat ke din ki ghabrahat dekhte. Ke harchand azab se chutkara chahenge. Lekin bachao ki koi surat nahin payenge. Na bhag kar, na chup kar, na kisi ki himayat se, na kisi ki panah se. Balkeh foran hi qareeb se pakad liye jayenge. Idhar qabron se nikle idhar phans liye gaye. Idhar khade hue idhar giraftar kar liye gaye. Yeh bhi matlab ho sakta hai ke qatl-o-aseer hue. Lekin sahih yahi hai ke murad Qayamat ke din ke azab hain. Baaz kehte hain Bani Abbas ki khilafat ke zamane mein Makkah Madine ke darmiyan in lashkaron ka zameen mein dhansaya jana murad hai. Ibn-e-Jarir ne ise bayan kar ke is ki daleel mein ek hadith warid ki hai jo bilkul hi mauzoo aur ghadi hui hai. Lekin ta'ajjub sa ta'ajjub hai ke Imam sahab ne is ka mauzoo hona bayan nahin kiya. Qayamat ke din kahenge ke hum iman qabool karte hain Allah par, us ke farishton par, us ki kitabon par, us ke rasoolon par iman laye. Jaise aur ayat mein hai (Wa lau tara izil-mujrimoona nakisu ru'usihim inda rabbihim, rabbana absarna wa sami'na farji'na na'mal salihan inna muqinoon) (Surah (As-Sajdah: 12), kaash ke tu dekhta jabke gunahgar log apne Rab ke samne sar-nigoon khade honge aur sharmindagi se keh rahe honge ke Allah hum ne dekh sun liya, hamein yaqeen aa gaya. Ab to hamein phir se duniya mein bhej de to hum dil se manenge. Lekin koi shakhs jis tarah bahut door ki cheez ko lene ke liye door se hi hath badhaye aur us ke hath nahin aa sakti. Isi tarah yahi haal in logon ka hai ke akhirat mein woh kaam karte hain jo duniya mein karna chahiye tha. To akhirat mein iman lana besood hai. Ab na duniya mein lautaye jayen na us waqt ki girya-o-zari, tauba-o-faryad, iman-o-islam kuch kaam aayega. Is se pehle duniya mein to munkir rahe. Na Allah ko mana na Rasool par iman laye na Qayamat ke qail hue, yunhi jaise koi bin dekhe andaze se hi nishane par teer-bazi kar raha ho isi tarah Allah ki baton ko apne guman se hi rad karte rahe. Nabi (ﷺ) ko kabhi kahin keh diya kabhi shair bata diya. Kabhi jadugar kaha aur kabhi majnoon. Sirf atkal-pachoo ke sath Qayamat ko jhutlate rahe aur be-daleel adaron ki ibadat karte rahe, jannat dozakh ka mazaq udate rahe, ab iman aur in mein hijab aa gaya. Tauba mein aur in mein parda pad gaya. Duniya in se chhoot gayi. Yeh duniya se alag ho gaye. Ibn-e-Abi Hatim mein yahan par ek ajeeb-o-ghareeb asar naqal kiya hai jise hum poora hi naqal karte hain. Hazrat Ibn-e-Abbas (R.A) se marwi hai ke Bani Israel mein ek fatih shakhs tha jis ke paas maal bahut tha. Jab woh mar gaya aur us ka ladka us ka waris hua to buri tarah nafarmaniyon mein maal lutane laga. Us ke chachaon ne use malamat ki aur samjhaya us ne gusse mein aa kar sab cheezein bech kar rupiya le kar ain Shijajah ke paas aa kar ek mahal tameer kara kar yahan rehne laga.

Us ne kaha haan. Pucha aap ki biwi bhi hai? Kaha nahin. Kaha phir tum apni zindagi ka lutf kya uthate ho? Ab us ne pucha ke kya tumhara khawand hai? Us ne kaha nahin. Kaha phir mujhe qabool karo. Us ne jawab diya main yahan se meel bhar door rehti hun, kal tum yahan se apne saath din bhar ka khana peena le kar chalo aur mere haan aao. Raaste mein kuch ajaibat dekho to ghabrana nahin. Us ne qabool kiya aur dusre din tosha le kar chala. Meel bhar door ja kar ek nihayat aali-shan mahal dekha. Dastak dene se ek khubsurat naujawan shakhs aaya. Pucha aap kaun hain? Jawab diya ke main Bani Israel hun. Kaha kaise aaye hain? Kaha is makan ki malka ne bulwaya hai. Pucha raaste mein kuch holnak cheezein bhi dekhein? Main chala, ek chauray raaste par pahuncha to dekha ke ek kutiya munh phaare baithi hui hai. Umeed poori hone se pehle rooh parwaz kar gayi. Phir farmata hai unse pehle ki ummaton ke saath bhi yahi kiya gaya woh bhi maut ke waqt zindagi aur imaan ki aarzoo karte rahe. Jo mehez besood thi. Jaise farman-e-aali shaan hai (Falamma ra'au ba'sana qalu amanna billahi wahdahu wa kafarna bima kunna bihi mushrikeen) (Surah (Al-Mu'min: 84).

(Ghafir: 84) Jab unhon ne hamara azab dekh liya toh kehne lage hum Allah Wahid par iman laye aur jis jis ko hum shareek-e-Allah banate thay un sab se hum inkar karte hain lekin us waqt un ke iman ne unhein koi faida na diya. Un se pehluon mein bhi yahi tariqa jari raha, kuffar nafa se mehroom hi hain. Yahan farmaya ke duniya mein toh zindagi bhar shak-o-shuba mein aur taraddud mein hi rahe. Isi wajah se azab ke dekhne ke baad ka iman bekar raha. Hazrat Qatadah (R.H) ka yeh qaul aab-e-zar se likhne ke laiq hai, aap farmate hain ke shubhat aur shukook se bacho. Is par jis ki maut aayi woh Qayamat ke din bhi isi par uthaya jayega aur jo yaqeen par mara hai use yaqeen par hi uthaya jayega.)))
